title: Staff AI Engineer — Agent Platform (all genders)
description:
wingmaite captures the knowledge companies never write down: who decides what, how work actually gets done, and why decisions were made. Our AI agents use that knowledge to answer questions and get work done.

We're looking for a Staff engineer to own the technical quality and direction of our agent platform. You'll build features end to end, from the agent into the backend. You won't manage people. You'll work closely with our CTO as a technical sparring partner.

What You'll Do

  • Design the agents: Decide how our agents plan, use tools and handle multi-step work, and where people need to step in. Build reusable components so each new use case doesn't need its own system.

  • Connect agents to company knowledge: Build how that knowledge reaches the agents, together with the people who decide what it should contain.

  • Make answers reliable: Agents should be correct, cite their sources, show people only what they're allowed to see, and know when not to act.

  • Track quality: Build evals, monitor quality and cost, and keep our model choices up to date.

  • Ship end to end: Build features from the agent through to the backend yourself.

  • Keep the architecture consistent: Set the patterns others build on, document decisions, keep specs current, and review designs with engineering, product and design.

How We Work

We build features as one team: design, product, engineering and AI together, from the first idea to production. You'll help shape a feature while it's still a problem and stay with it until it works for users. Agents depend on the knowledge behind them, so we build both as one system. We write decisions down and discuss disagreements openly.

What This Role Is Not

A management role, a prompt-engineering role, or an infrastructure or securit

title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
description:

Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing.

While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities

Automate the operations behind every meter exchange

  • Map end-to-end operational processes with the team, then design automations that handle every edge case.

title: Product Specialist
description:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

  • Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

Your Role

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer you will own the methodology, planning, and execution of mixed-signal verification for digital-to-analog interfaces on Arago's Systems-on-Chip, working across analog, RTL, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure correct integration and drive verification to sign-off.

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

  • Translate optical design requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs

  • Perform tolerance analysis to ensure optical alignment and performance across manufacturing variation

About the company

Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

Our platform makes it easy for brands to keep products in circulation and for customers to shop secondhand with confidence.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

title: Database Engineering Intern
description:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.

Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks.

  • Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled.

  • Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed.

  • Improve our data models: reduce duplicated values and work with references and views.

  • Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference.

  • Review our database access policies.

Requirements

  • You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar.

  • Comfortable in SQL: joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan.

  • You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it.

  • PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus.

  • Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools.

title: Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description:
In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀

Aufgaben

  • Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen.
  • Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung.
  • Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance.
  • Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden.
  • Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen.
  • PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren.

Qualifikation

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortl

title: Credit Manager (H/F)
description:
Chez EndLess, un service rendu est un service payé.

Nous collectons, trions et valorisons les déchets de chantier des professionnels du BTP en Île-de-France et dans le Sud : Big Bags, bennes, apport sur site, et une plateforme digitale propriétaire qui pilote nos flux en temps réel. Le groupe réalise 20 M€ de chiffre d’affaires, compte 25 personnes dans ses bureaux de Paris 15e, et grandit par croissance organique et par acquisitions.

Nous créons le poste de Credit Manager. Soyons francs : c’est un poste de terrain dans une PME, pas un poste de pilotage à distance. Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui prend le téléphone, traite les litiges et mène ses dossiers de bout en bout.

Votre mission

Faire en sorte que chacune de nos prestations se transforme en cash, vite et proprement. Vous gérez l’ensemble du portefeuille clients en autonomie, sans équipe à encadrer, et vous êtes rattaché(e) à notre Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Le travail répétitif est déjà automatisé : chaque matin, un agent IA prépare votre liste d’appels priorisée, suit les promesses de paiement et surveille les procédures collectives. Vous gardez ce qui fait la différence : le téléphone, le jugement, la décision.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Appeler chaque jour vos clients, obtenir des engagements de paiement datés et chiffrés, et les faire tenir.

title: Head of Research & Editorial
description:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, and London and Dubai opening this year.

Why this role

Frontline labour markets are badly measured. Governments publish unemployment and vacancy statistics. Nobody publishes a credible number for how long it takes to get a qualified person from application to first shift, what that delay costs, or how much of it is regulatory rather than operational.

We see activation at scale, across sectors and jurisdictions, so we can measure what nobody else can. Publishing it sets the terms of the debate, gives policymakers something real to work with, and gives our commercial teams something better than a pitch deck. The standard we are aiming at is work a member of government or tier one investor forwards along to their colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Set the research agenda

  • Write and publish flagship reports and white papers

  • Own editorial standards across everything Firstwork publishes

  • Build data stories with our data and engineering teams

  • Lead policy engagement on European labour and employment regulat

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: ML Compiler & System
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

 

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.   About The Team   The Customer Success team helps customers turn Skydio into a reliable, repeatable, and enduring operating advantage. We are a rapidly growing team of passionate, mission-driven professionals, who sweat the details and ensure our customers are set up for success.   About The Role   We are looking for a motivated Customer Success Manager with a deep sense of ownership to lead and drive all aspects of implementation, usage and adoption, retention and expansion of our Canadian public sector and commercial customers. A successful candidate will become an indispensable bridge between our customers and Skydio’s extremely agile and world class technical teams. This role reports to the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Customer Success and will work closely with our Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering functions to deliver industry leading autonomous solutions that drive value for our customers.   Location:  Based in Canada, British Columbia or Ontario, with convenient access to a major airport. This is a remote position with expected travel to customer and Skydio locations.   How You’ll Make An Impact     Operate independently and help shape the Canadian GTM and customer success strategy.  Build scalable processes for customer on-boarding, account management and post sales success.  Track and manage all implementation projects with large enterprise customers for successful delivery of technology, services, and program outcomes.  Develop healthy customer relationships and create customer loyalty through proactive engagement, cadence based follow ups, and business reviews.  Quantify product feedback and brief executives to help drive product roadmap that aligns to customers and market needs  Manage ~20x accounts driving adoption to ensure expansions and renewals within the assigned book of business.     What Makes You a Good Fit     Strong knowledge or previous experience supporting customers in at least one of the following industries: public industries (public safety, transportation) or commercial industries (utilities, oil & gas, AEC).  Proven track record of implementing and scaling new programs and technology, driving adoption of hardware and software, and interfacing with technical teams to deliver on customer schedules.  Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and a strong focus on project management tools and concepts.  Work directly with customers through proactive, metrics based engagement. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager – Scaling AI Project Management Platform      Are you an ambitious Customer Success professional ready to help traditional, heavy-hitting industries modernise the way they build, move, and operate?     Our client is a high-growth tech scale-up transforming project delivery with their all-in-one AI project management platform. Built to serve project-intensive sectors such as construction, engineering, logistics, mining and manufacturing, their platform automates everything from site documentation and contract tracking to multi-million-dollar financials, timelines, and communications.     As a Customer Success Manager, you will serve as the strategic bridge between technology and real-world site and supply chain operations. You’ll partner with key accounts to drive onboarding, embed automated workflows deep into their daily operations, ensure maximum ROI, and unlock long-term portfolio growth.      On offer:  $120,000 – $150,000 + Super + Bonus      Key Responsibilities:    Lead end-to-end customer onboarding and system adoption, taking clients from contract signature to fully automated project execution.  Partner directly with Project Directors, Operations Leads, and Commercial Managers, translating complex AI capabilities into tangible time and cost savings on site.  Proactively monitor account health, usage signals, and operational bottlenecks to pre-empt risk, drive engagement, and maintain industry-leading retention rates.  Identify expansion, upsell, and multi-project rollout opportunities, collaborating closely with the Account Executive team.  Act as the internal voice of the customer, working with Product and Engineering to continuously tailor the platform to field and operational demands.       What You'll Bring:    2–3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Implementation within a fast-moving B2B SaaS environment.  High comfort level dealing with pragmatic, operationally minded clients (experience or familiarity with construction, supply chain, engineering, or industrial workflows is a strong advantage).  A data-driven mindset with the ability to measure outcomes, deliver impactful Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and demonstrate clear operational ROI.  Strong project management chops, empathy, and the agility to navigate rapidly evolving platform features.  Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing both on-site operators and head-office executives.      This is a rare opportunity to join a scaling AI disruptor at a pivotal stage, work with massive industry players, and shape customer success playbooks from the ground up.     Click ‘Apply Now’ or alternatively, send your CV directly through to either jackson@techiumconsulting.com or shiv@techiumconsulting.com.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Het Customer Succes team is verantwoordelijk voor het beheren en het uitbouwen van het huidige klantportfolio, dat gebruik maakt van onze verzuimsoftware. Samen met vier Customer Success Managers help je bestaande klanten om efficiënter en effectiever gebruik te maken van onze softwareoplossing. Als CSM heb je twee belangrijke doelstellingen waar we actief op sturen: klantwaarde en klanttevredenheid. Je hebt jouw eigen klanten waarmee je vooral op tactisch en strategisch niveau een langdurige klantrelatie opbouwt. Jij bent de “trusted advisor” voor de beslissers bij de klant en samen kijken we continue naar extra mogelijkheden en kansen, en helpt jij samen met alle collega’s de klanten het optimale uit de software te halen.      Functieomschrijving   Als Customer Success Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onboarden van nieuwe klanten, ondersteund door een projectteam. Je onderhoudt relaties met klanten op verschillende niveaus binnen hun organisatie, met de focus op klanttevredenheid, -behoud en groei van de portefeuille. Je zorgt voor omzetgroei door upsell/cross-sell en analyseert zowel klantdoelstellingen als die van je eigen organisatie om deze te bereiken.     Je fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en wijst hen op beschikbare resources, zoals kennisbanken, trainingen en handleidingen. Daarnaast monitor je de opvolging van taken, ondersteund door de binnendienst, en analyseer je klantfeedback om producten en klanttevredenheid te verbeteren. Je onderhoudt nauw contact met klanten en interne opdrachtverantwoordelijken, zoals de Lead of Project Manager.     Je bent alert op ontwikkelingen bij klanten die kunnen leiden tot het reduceren of beëindigen van de dienstverlening en onderneemt initiatieven om klanttevredenheid te verbeteren waar nodig. Je houdt jezelf op de hoogte van relevante trends, ontwikkelingen in de markt, productkennis en processen.     Tot slot bewaak je, met ondersteuning van de binnendienst, de naleving van gemaakte afspraken, zoals vastgelegd in DAP, SLA's, werkopdrachten en bijbehorende KPI's. Je stelt DAP's op, waarbij klantbehoeften vertaald worden naar concrete afspraken, en rapporteert over prestaties aan in- en externe stakeholders.      Over jou    HBO werk en denkniveau (bij voorkeur Bedrijfskundig, IT, Commerciële Economie);  Je hebt bij voorkeur minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Account Manager, SLA en/of Delivery Manager, Consultant of Project Manager;  Je hebt kennis van (markt- en klant)ontwikkelingen in het vakgebied van bedrijfsgezondheid en sociale zekerheid;  Je hebt kennis van projectmanagement en IT-beheer methodieken;  Je bent klantgericht;  Je beschikt over commercieel inzicht;  Je bent communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;  Je bent in staat om vanuit een helikopter view te werken;  Je legt makkelijk contact en is in staat relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden.      Deze eisen en vaardigheden geven een richting van het profiel dat wij zoeken

title: Low-touch Customer Success Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Low-touch Customer Success Manager based in Netherlands.   Join a fast-growing, remote-first technology environment focused on helping businesses unlock the potential of automation and AI-powered workflows.  As a Customer Success Manager, you will manage a portfolio of approximately 30 enterprise accounts across the EMEA region, serving as their primary post-sales partner.  You will guide customers through onboarding, adoption, and renewal while helping them translate product usage into measurable business outcomes.  By building strong relationships with technical teams and executive stakeholders, you will drive customer engagement, satisfaction, and long-term value.  You will proactively monitor account health, identify risks, and coordinate solutions across internal teams.  You will also contribute to scalable customer success programs and playbooks that strengthen retention, expansion, and enterprise growth.  Accountabilities   Responsibilities   As the primary post-sales contact for a portfolio of enterprise customers, you will ensure successful adoption, measurable value realization, and sustainable account growth. Your responsibilities will include:    Manage a portfolio of approximately 30 enterprise customers across EMEA, supporting them throughout onboarding, adoption, and renewal.   Lead customer kickoffs and success planning sessions, aligning stakeholders on objectives, timelines, responsibilities, and measurable outcomes.   Coordinate onboarding and enablement for technical and business audiences, accelerating time-to-value and resolving implementation challenges.   Establish a consistent customer engagement cadence through health checks, executive meetings, adoption reviews, and quarterly business reviews.   Monitor customer health indicators and product usage data to identify risks early, manage escalations, and maintain stakeholder alignment.   Demonstrate customer value by translating product adoption into measurable business outcomes, efficiency improvements, and compelling ROI narratives.   Identify and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with Account Executives, contributing to retention and account expansion.   Collaborate with Support, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Sales teams to resolve customer blockers and deliver a seamless experience.   Share structured customer feedback with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and product improvements.   Contribute to scalable customer success playbooks, processes, and programs that improve outcomes across the wider customer base.      Requirements   You are an experienced enterprise customer success professional who combines technical understanding, commercial awareness, and a strong focus on customer outcomes. You should bring:    Proven experience managing a portfolio of enterprise SaaS customers

title: Team Manager
description: About Us    The Department of Government Services (DGS) was established on 1 January 2023 to improve everyone’s experience of doing business and interacting with the Victorian government. We bring important day-to-day services together in one department to make things easy and seamless for Victorians and businesses. We are doing this by connecting and digitising our systems and platforms across state and local government as well as streamlining our corporate and procurement services.  You can find out more about our Ministers, leadership and entities here: Department of Government Services. We operate a tiered support model incorporating contact centres dedicated to providing fast, empathetic and effective solutions across a range of channels including phone, email and digital chat. We are a data driven team that uses real customer feedback to help the rest of the department improve it’s products and services for Victorians. title: Client Services Team Leader - AEC Moorabbin
description: Job Description    We are seeking an experienced  Client Services Team Leader , to lead and supervise our strong Client Service Representative team, driving improvements in service delivery and fostering a positive and cohesive team culture.    The successful candidate will be critical in ensuring our clients receive outstanding customer service. You will be dedicated, conscientious, with a genuine love for animals   and effective in your written and verbal communication with clients and other hospital staff.     As a part of the Client Services team, your duties will include:       Handling a high volume of inbound calls and email enquiries  Managing all client inquiries and concerns with professionalism and empathy  Welcoming clients and their pets to the hospital  Booking and managing appointments in emergency and speciality departments  Invoicing and taking payments – including cash and EFTPOS  Processing payments on Vetpay, Zippay and Afterpay  Processing GapOnly and managing Insurance Claims  Coordinating with other hospital departments to ensure seamless client experiences  Data entry and requesting documents from referring vets and clients  Liaising with referring vets  Overseeing the rostering of your direct reports and managing timecards and leave requests  Undertaking training, mentoring, and leadership for your direct reports  Ad-hoc administrative duties  As a 24/7 hospital, shifts will include weekdays, weekends, public holidays and evenings    In addition to the above, the Client Services Team Lead will oversee all aspects of customer care ensuring exceptional service delivery, while providing leadership and support to the Client Services team. Duties of this role will also see you;      Foster a positive and engaged team culture, promoting collaboration and professional development  Drive improvements in client service processes and performance  Monitor and report on client service metrics and implement strategies for continuous improvement  Provide training and support to our Client Services Team    About You:      Proven experience in a client services role, preferably in a healthcare or veterinary setting  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills  Adaptable and takes initiative, this role requires you to be able to multitask and have a proactive attitude  Attention to detail  Strong conflict resolution skills  A calm and empathetic approach to your work  A passion for delivering outstanding client service  Previous team management and leadership experience    What we want to offer you:      A crucial role within a leading veterinary hospital focusing on client service excellence  A modern and spacious hospital and a workplace that is focused on employee wellbeing and professional satisfaction  Employee benefits including discounts on veterinary services, discounts at retail stores and more!  The chance to make a meaningful impact on client satisfaction and team engagement    APPLY NOW!

title: Reception & Client Services Manager
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Reception & Client Services Manager to join a dynamic and fast-paced post-production company based in Dublin. This role offers the chance to work in a creative environment where your organisational skills and client service expertise will shine—all while interacting with high-profile clients, directors, and even the occasional celebrity visitor. Organise internal events such as Christmas parties and other celebrations to foster a positive workplace culture. title: Servicemanager IT
description: Functieomschrijving   Dankzij de diensten van Logius kunnen burgers inloggen met DigiD, hun gegevens bekijken in MijnOverheid en kunnen overheidsorganisaties veilig en betrouwbaar gegevens met elkaar uitwisselen. Achter deze digitale dienstverlening gaat een complexe IT-keten schuil, waarin continuïteit, kwaliteit en samenwerking essentieel zijn. Als Servicemanager IT bij Logius zorg jij ervoor dat deze dienstverlening betrouwbaar blijft functioneren en zich verder kan ontwikkelen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt verschillende partijen en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Zo lever je in Den Haag een belangrijke bijdrage aan een digitale overheid die werkt voor iedereen.    Jouw uitdaging als Servicemanager IT? Zorgen voor betrouwbare dienstverlening in een complexe IT-keten   Als Servicemanager IT Ga Je Aan De Slag Binnen De Directie Productiehuis, In De ART Gegevensgebruik. Binnen Deze ART Werken Verschillende Teams Aan Voorzieningen Waarmee Overheidsorganisaties Gegevens Met Elkaar Kunnen Uitwisselen En Gebruiken. Denk Bijvoorbeeld Aan    Digilevering: levert gebeurtenissen uit overheidsregistraties aan aangesloten afnemers;  Digimelding: biedt organisaties de mogelijkheid om fouten in basisregistraties te melden en te corrigeren;  COR/OIN: ondersteunt betrouwbare gegevensuitwisseling met een register en identificatienummers voor organisaties.    De diensten worden gebruikt door onder andere gemeenten, overheids- en uitvoeringsorganisaties en ketenpartners. Hoewel burgers niet rechtstreeks gebruikmaken van deze voorzieningen, zijn ze wel belangrijk voor allerlei overheidsprocessen en uiteindelijk voor de dienstverlening aan burgers en bedrijven.  Als Servicemanager IT ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van één of meerdere diensten binnen deze ART. Je werkt volgens de SAFe-methodiek, in een omgeving waarin Agile- en DevOps-teams in sprints van twee weken samenwerken aan beheer en doorontwikkeling. Samen met de Product Owner en de verschillende teams zorg je ervoor dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de gemaakte afspraken en verwachtingen van afnemers en leveranciers. Je houdt daarbij niet alleen zicht op de dagelijkse dienstverlening, maar kijkt ook vooruit. Binnen de ART Gegevensgebruik staan de komende jaren verschillende veranderingen op de agenda. Denk aan het uitfaseren van bestaande systemen, het terugdringen van technische schuld en de migratie naar het Logius Platform Common (LPC). Ook wordt gewerkt aan het opbouwen van een Configuration Management Database (CMDB) en het verbeteren van processen rondom forecasting en lifecyclemanagement. Als IT Servicemanager speel je een belangrijke rol bij het beheerst uitvoeren van deze veranderingen, waarbij je steeds de balans bewaakt tussen vernieuwing en continuïteit.  In de praktijk betekent dit dat je regelmatig te maken krijgt met uiteenlopende situaties. Bijvoorbeeld wanneer een verstoring meerdere onderdelen van de IT-keten raakt en verschillende interne

description: We’re looking for a Bank Implementation Manager to join our team and help clients connect their banks, set up workflows, and get the most out of our platform from day one. We welcome high performers who thrive in dynamic, client-focused environments.     At Cobase, we’re helping companies take back control of their banking and treasury operations.  Many mid-sized and large businesses manage multiple banks, dozens of accounts, and complex finance structures often spread across countries, currencies, and entities. It’s messy, inefficient, and hard to manage. That’s where we come in.  Cobase offers a single platform where finance teams can handle payments, cash management, and other treasury functionality all connected to their ERP or accounting system. No more jumping between portals or spreadsheets.  We work with international corporates, growing groups, and private equity-backed companies who want to simplify their financial operations and increase control.      The role: help our customers hit the ground running.   We’re looking for a Bank Implementation Manager to join our team and lead clients through onboarding and setup. We value proactive, high-performing professionals who thrive in dynamic environments.  In this role, you’ll partner with banks to ensure Cobase is up and running quickly connecting banks, configuring payments and reporting, and establishing payment products. Positioned at the intersection of finance, technology, you’ll play a key role in delivering a seamless start for our clients.      What you will do:    Act as the main point of contact for banks during onboarding of our clients  Coordinate bank integrations with both client stakeholders and bank teams  Establishing technical connectivity such as SWIFT, SFTP, EBICS and API  Troubleshoot issues and collaborate with our support and product teams when needed  Gather and share feedback to improve our platform and services  Partner with some of worlds most dynamic finance teams and banks.          What we are looking for:    Result-oriented mindset with a “get things done” approach  Strong communication skills and a structured way of working  Fluent in English and at least one other language  Comfortable working with technology, banking, or finance tools  Ability to engage confidently with both IT and Finance stakeholders  Prior experience in treasury, payments, ERP, or financial implementation is a strong advantage  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience  Hands-on, proactive, and eager to take ownership       Must to have EU citizenship with the right to work in the Netherlands.

With over  12,000 employees  and a presence in more than  135 countries , we are united by a shared purpose: to make life-saving technology accessible to more people. Based in Brisbane, Sydney or Melbourne, we are looking for a Commercial Manager - Service to join the Getinge Service & Projects team and play a pivotal role in driving the growth, profitability and commercial performance of our service business across Australia and New Zealand. Lead the commercial management of strategic service accounts, building strong customer relationships and driving contract retention, growth and profitability. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten.

Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Was du tun wirst

In einem Satz: Du bist SDR #1 und baust die Engine, die unsere Inbound-Leads zuverlässig in gebuchte Demos verwandelt. Du testest Messaging, entwickelst Prozesse und findest heraus, was am besten funktioniert, ob Telefon, Automatisierung oder KI-Agent.

  • Du baust praxipals Go-to-Market-Motion von Grund auf mit auf: Du entwickelst Playbooks und Gesprächsleitfäden, die zum Standard für unser wachsendes Sales-Team werden

  • Du spielst eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, ein leistungsstarkes Sales-Tea

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

title: Senior IoT Engineer (all genders) – Embedded Linux · Python · Yocto
description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Next-Gen OS Image: Design and build our new Yocto-based Linux image for the next hardware generation, and drive the migration of our fleet onto it.

  • Hardware Abstraction: Harmonize the software across scanners, payment terminals and screens into one maintainable codebase.

description:
Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter.

Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen.

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersec

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. About Quandela

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

🎯 Focus: Shape what our customers can buy, when it arrives and how it gets there, and untangle the monolith behind it.

About Product at Bloom & Wild 🌸

We're Europe's largest direct-to-consumer flower and gifting business (Bloom & Wild, bloomon and Bergamotte), now growing into cakes, candles and hampers. Our 16-strong Product team works in 8 squads, with fortnightly sprints and quarterly OKRs, across London, Amsterdam and fully remote. You'll own the roadmap for our delivery and availability systems and guide a squad of 6 alongside a technical lead. Much of this lives in a large monolith that has grown with the business, and you'll help us untangle it: setting clear domain boundaries and making sure every change lands safely, especially around Christmas and Mother's Day. You'll work with Operations, Commercial and Logistics, and use AI to move faster.

  • Roadmap Ownership: Own the DAM roadmap, balancing a cleaner domain-driven architecture with commercial value along the way.

  • Monolith Untangling: Choose what to change and when, so every release lands safely for customers, warehouse and logistics teams.

  • Range & Carrier Growth: Launch new carriers and more complex product categories with Operations, Commercial and Logistics.

  • Data & AI: Shape clean data models and interfaces that enable automation and agentic commerce, using AI tools (including MCP-based tooling) for research, debugging and analysis.

  • Define quality standards and acceptance criteria for preference data, model comparisons, and evaluation outputs. 
  • Monitor delivery quality, investigate inconsistencies, and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients. 
  • Advise on data design, evaluation approaches, and project feasibility based on your domain expertise.

title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Health Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo HealthTech
description:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès

Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

  • nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
  • quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
  • nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.



Tes missions

La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.

Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.

Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.

Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer

Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients. 

Ton équipe :
Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client, réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, ils collaborent étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

title: CTO Cloud - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud - H/F
description:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et réalisation en technologie digitale. Theodo Cloud, fondée en 2018, est l'entité experte DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction et le RUN d'applications performantes, sécurisées et scalables. L'entité travaille avec des clients comme Renault, Believe, Safran, Thales, BNP ou Bpifrance.

Le marché du cloud est en pleine accélération : les entreprises doivent migrer leurs infrastructures on-premise, maîtriser leurs coûts cloud (FinOps), sécuriser leurs environnements et adopter des architectures cloud-native pour accompagner leur croissance. Theodo Cloud a une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en s'appuyant sur son approche Lean Tech et ses partenariats avec AWS, Google Cloud, S3ns, Scaleway et Outscale.

  • offre : avancer l’effort sur la pertinence des offres

    • développement d'enablers internes (frameworks d'audit infra, accélérateurs de migration)
    • animation des tech cloud / followers internes
    • formalisation des apprentissages et bonnes pratiques (secure by design, FinOps, IaC)

title: CTO - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
description:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI, qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA.

Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
Build security platforms, not security processes

We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.

This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.

You will operate across two horizons:

  • Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

  • Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris.

Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique.

Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois.

Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

title: Flight Software Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

At The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx - a modular, reusable orbital vehicle for space missions to stations and beyond. Nyx is engineered with the capability to transport cargo and, in the future, humans.

We are seeking a highly motivated Flight Software Engineer to join our mission-driven team developing Nyx. In this role, you will take full ownership of key components of the flight software stack. You will be designing, implementing, and testing mission-critical systems that enable safe, autonomous, and reliable spaceflight operations.

You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where cross-functional integration is essential. Your code will interface directly with vehicle avionics, guidance systems, propulsion, communications, and ground control. Expect to write modern, high-reliability C++ and Python code, drive software simulations, and ensure flight readiness through rigorous testing at both unit and system levels.

The position level will be determined based on your experience, technical depth, and ability to take ownership.

description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

title: Lead Tech SRE
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.
