title: Senior Director, Health & Safety Operations Europe
Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Knuspr zählt Geschwindigkeit. Qualität zählt. Aber nichts davon funktioniert ohne Menschen, die vom ersten Tag an genau wissen, was sie tun.

Genau hier kommen unsere Trainer ins Spiel.

Wir suchen einen Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d), der neuen Kolleg:innen hilft, sich schnell einzuarbeiten, die Abläufe richtig zu lernen und sich zu selbstbewussten, leistungsstarken Teammitgliedern zu entwickeln. Diese Rolle verbindet Onboarding, Coaching und Kulturarbeit – und ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dafür, wie gut unsere Teams im Lager funktionieren.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, durch Vorleben erklärst und andere jeden Tag besser machen willst, könnte das gut zu dir passen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell neue Mitarbeitende produktiv und sicher arbeiten

  • Du prägst die Teamkultur auf der Lagerfläche – nicht vom Schreibtisch aus

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften zusammen und bist wichtiger Partner für Performance, Onboarding und Entwicklung

  • Du unterstützt sowohl neue als auch bestehende Mitarbeitende – kein Tag ist wie der andere

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

You will work closely with Project Managers and teams across Munich, Bordeaux and Turin to ensure that planning information is collected, structured and available for effective programme decision-making.

This is a junior position offering broad exposure to program management, project planning and the development of a complex space vehicle.

title: Senior Prototype Machinist
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

[Deutsche Version weiter unten]

Your Mission

At The Exploration Company, we develop, manufacture, and operate Nyx — a modular, reusable orbital spacecraft designed to be refuelled in orbit and transport cargo, with crewed missions potentially planned for the longer term.

We’re looking for a hands-on, technically mature professional with an engineering degree or extensive CNC experience to take full ownership of the machining process for space-grade components. You’ll be responsible for CAM programming, machine setup and optimisation, and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute directly to future investments in machining equipment and tooling.

You’ll work on a variety of high-precision parts, including rocket engine components, post-processed metal 3D-printed parts, and critical propulsion subcomponents. You’ll work across a fleet of modern, multi-brand, 5-axis machining centres and CNC lathes.

This role offers a high-impact technical position, with opportunities for career growth and increased responsibility.

Fluency in English is expected, as our work environment is international.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define and optimise machining strategies, including sequencing, tooling, fixtures, and in-process controls.

  • Program complex components in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software for 5-axis milling and CNC turning.

  • Validate parts using multi-brand CNC equipment, ensuring that they meet tolerance and surface-finish requirements.

description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

title: Investor in Residence
description:
About the role

You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do.

We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. We run on our own stack for sourcing, diligence and portfolio work, and people who've seen it call it the most advanced VC stack they know.

What you'll do

  • Work on live deals from the first call to IC, and bring an operator's or investor's judgement to them

  • Shape investment theses in the markets you know best

  • Work with portfolio founders on the problems you've already solved: hiring, product, go-to-market, their next round

  • Help build the platform. If you think in systems or write code, there's a lot to push further.

  • Use the time and the network to work out your own next step. If that turns out to be a company we'd back, even better.

title: Visiting Analyst (Technical)

We're looking for a Visiting Analyst to join our Berlin office for six to nine months.

You're a student or recent graduate with a technical background: engineering, computer science, maths, physics or another science. You want to see what early-stage investing is like from the inside, and you can build things.

That second part matters. A large part of this role is building how PT1 works. We run on our own stack for sourcing, diligence and portfolio work, and people who've seen it call it the most advanced VC stack they know. You'll help us push it further.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. That includes people who were only with us for a few months.

The job

  • Improve our platform. Build and extend the tools, data pipelines and AI workflows the team uses every day. You'll own projects, not tickets.

  • Research markets and help develop investment theses. We start from a view on where a market is going, then look for the companies that fit it.

  • Work on live deals with the team: screening, market and competitor research, first models, memo sections.

About you

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input.

We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows.

title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

title: Senior Compliance Associate - Automation & Systems
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Compliance team at Payward plays a critical role in enabling the company to grow responsibly while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory environment. Our teams work across jurisdictions and product lines to design and maintain scalable compliance frameworks that support Payward’s mission while ensuring regulatory obligations are met.

The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Scale Team is responsible for ensuring the FIU can scale, across new operating jurisdictions and new products, effectively and efficiently. The team leads AML transaction monitoring and blockchain monitoring to ensure thresholds are appropriately set, tested, and governed while reducing false positives and maintaining strong oversight. In addition, the team focuses on identifying efficiencies in process workflows and implementing automation across the FIU. Scale works closely with external vendor, Compliance, and internal technology teams.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

description: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una  Customer Service Manager  che, riportando al Supply Chain Manager, sia responsabile della gestione e del coordinamento delle attività di Customer Service, garantendo un'efficace gestione degli ordini e un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente. La persona si occuperà di:    Supervisionare e coordinare il team Customer Service Representative , supportandolo nella gestione delle attività quotidiane e occupandoti della formazione e dello sviluppo delle persone.  Collaborare con le diverse funzioni aziendali coinvolte nel processo d'ordine per assicurare la corretta definizione dei capitolati di produzione e la regolare evasione degli ordini.  Collaborare con il  team Sales  per monitorare il flusso degli ordini ed evidenziare eventuali scostamenti rispetto al budget.  Lavorare con la pianificazione nell'analisi del portafoglio ordini, facilitando la risoluzione delle eventuali criticità.  Monitorare le performance  OTIF (On Time In Full)  dei clienti e definirai, in collaborazione con le funzioni coinvolte, eventuali piani di miglioramento.  Collaborare con i  Project Manager  per ottimizzare le tempistiche e assicurare la completezza delle informazioni necessarie alla definizione dei capitolati. Ottima conoscenza della lingua  inglese,  la conoscenza del francese costituisce un plus.  Ottime capacità di  teamworking e people management .  Spiccate capacità organizzative e di gestione delle priorità.  Forte orientamento al  problem solving  e alla ricerca di soluzioni.  Capacità di prendere decisioni in modo pragmatico.  Proattività, precisione e attenzione ai dettagli e ai numeri.

title: CX Development Manager
description: Every NOBA customer relationship starts with an application. You will make it count.   As  CX Development Manager , you will lead the development of our digital customer journeys across our brands and products. Your main focus is the path from started application to onboarded customer, and your scope also includes other digital customer interfaces, such as logged-in customer pages and apps. You are the front door for change. You drive what gets prioritized, make sure it is built right, and work with experimentation and tracking to prove with data that it worked.   Why this is a challenge worth taking   Digital Experience & Optimization is a new function within the CMO area. Our systematic, data-driven approach has already delivered clear results at Bank Norwegian, and now we are taking it to more brands and products. You will help define how that works in practice, in a regulated environment where every change must be both effective and compliant, and with many stakeholders pulling in different directions. We are also actively exploring how AI and agents can make the way we work more efficient, and you will help put that into practice.  You will work side by side with UX/UI, CRO, tracking & measurement and digital governance, and closely with Product Management, Product & Tech, Brand & Communication, Performance Marketing, Customer Engagement & Monetization, and Legal & Compliance. In this role you will report directly to Head of Digital Experience & Optimization, Fredrik Jansson.   What You Will Do     Be the front door for change: receive, qualify and prioritize requests from across the business, and keep a transparent backlog and roadmap. Application and onboarding are the main focus, alongside other digital customer interfaces.  Align with the business: make sure priorities for the digital customer interfaces fit with the commercial product roadmap and goals.  Find and size the opportunities: use data and analytics to see where customers drop off or run into friction, quantify the problem, and build business cases with expected impact.  Turn ideas into buildable requirements: write clear, testable requirements with acceptance criteria and measurement points that developers can build from.  Lead delivery to proven results: drive initiatives across UX, experimentation, tracking and governance, take part in acceptance testing, and make sure changes are validated through A/B tests and followed up over time, not just at launch.     Who You Are   You are proactive and curious. You bring the ideas instead of waiting for an order. You think analytically, build a strong case, and bring people with you, even when priorities compete. You believe AI and agents can make our work more efficient, and you want to be part of making that happen. You lead with warmth and are not afraid to say no with good reasons. description: Vi tycker att hemelektronik är fantastiskt. Vi vill därför ge fler mer glädje, avkoppling, och produktivitet i vardagen! Vi gör prylar tillgängligt för alla så enkelt, billigt och hållbart som möjligt. För att lyckas är så klart våra grymma medarbetare det viktigaste vi har. Är du med? Tjänsten är i grunden som lagershopsmedarbetare där det tillkommer ett ansvarstillägg för rollen som Kundserviceledare. Du kommer vara ansiktet utåt i vår Lagershop och aktivt arbeta med alltfrån försäljning, kassa och varuhantering till teknisk service/kundtjänst. Vårt team består av ett härligt gäng positiva och engagerade medarbetare som är grymma på butiksdrift.  Kundserviceledare leder och fördelararbetet i Lagershopens serviceområde (kassa och kundeservice). Rollen säkerställer god kundupplevelse, smidigt flöde, hög kvalitet och efterlevvnad av rutiner i alla servicepunkter. I rollen igår att ge kontinuerlig feedback på bemötande och arbetssätt, agera direkt på avvikelser och bidra till en trygg och strukturerad vardag i kassanlinje och serviceområde. Utöver ansvaret i serviceområdet förväntas rollen ta ett övergripande operativt ledarskap i butikens drift när andra ledare inte är på plats - med förmåga att prioritera, agera handlingskraftit och säkerställa att den dagliga verksamheten fungerar.  Vi erbjuder ett spännande och utvecklande arbete där du, tillsammans med dina kollegor i teamet, levererar grym kundervice till våra kunder. För att lyckas behöver du ha en vilja att lära dig mera om våra produkter och dessutom får du även möjlighet att utvecklas inom felsökning på produkter som du hanterar och försäljning.   Vem söker vi?   Du är serviceinriktad och brinner för att ge kunderna den bästa servicen. Som person är du lugn men med driv och vilja att få saker genomförda med ett bra resultat. Du är även ansvarsfull och smidig, samtidigt som du ser till att följa rutiner och riktlinjer. Dina vänner beskriver dig som ordningsam och du är en person som alltid frågar ”vad kan jag hjälpa till med?” även om det stundtals är högt tempo. Arbetet görs tillsammans med kollegorna i Lagershopen och att hjälps åt för att lösa dagens arbetsuppgifter är självklart för dig. title: Palvelujohtaja

Keskeisiä vastuitasi ovat:      Johdat ja kehität konsultoinnin, asiakaspalvelun ja Oscar Talousosaston muodostamaa noin 55 henkilön organisaatiota yhdessä sen esihenkilöiden kanssa.  Parannat palvelujen kannattavuutta, tuottavuutta ja laatua sekä vahvistat tiedolla johtamista.  Selkeytät tavoitteet, vastuut, mittarit ja johtamisrytmin sekä viet sovitut toimintamallit käytäntöön. title: Service Delivery Manager - IT Infrastructure
description: Job Description   Our infrastructure relies heavily on external partners, managed service providers, and vendors. We're looking for someone engaged, who will ensure that our suppliers deliver as agreed in terms of scope, budget and schedule.  In this role, you will be the person who holds suppliers accountable, runs the operational reviews, and steps in before a delayed delivery or an unresolved ticket turns into a business problem.  You will work closely with the HO IT Infrastructure to ensure that services are performing as expected.   What The Job Is     Run operational vendor management: Act as the primary operational contact for our infrastructure and network suppliers.  Enforce SLAs and deliverables: Track performance metrics closely. When a supplier misses an SLA or slips on a deadline, you address it early and drive the remediation plan.  Lead structured reviews: Chair regular service reviews (monthly/quarterly), track action items, and ensure unresolved operational issues are followed through to completion.  Partner with IT Procurement: Provide the operational data needed for contract renewals, dispute discussions, and vendor scorecards.  Handle escalations: Intervene when standard operational channels stall.     How Will You Contribute To The Team     Proven background: Solid experience in a Service Delivery, Vendor Management, or IT Operations role within an enterprise environment.  Infrastructure knowledge: A practical understanding of enterprise IT (cloud hosting, networks, on-prem hardware, data centers, security platforms). You must be able to follow technical discussions, challenge timelines and spot when a vendor is giving vague answers.  Commercial and contract awareness: Hands-on experience working against contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), and strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  Communication style: Firm, diplomatic, and articulate. You need to be able to say "no" or "this isn't acceptable" clearly and professionally.On the other hand, you would also be able to build good relations to continue the good corporation with our suppliers  Languages: Professional fluency in English (written and spoken). Danish language skills are a plus. Structured as a person (especially in written form).     Pluses (not Hard Requirements)     Practical knowledge about ITIL frameworks  Daily experience working on platforms like ServiceNow, and Jira. title: People & Delivery Lead, Technology & Operations
description: Vil du lede 15 specialister i drift, cloud og sikkerhed for fremtidens landbrug?      SEGES Innovation søger en erfaren IT-leder til Technology & Operations. title: Leder til Vedligeholdelsesområde for Jordbaseret Luftforsvar ved Flyvstation Tirstrup
description: Leder til Vedligeholdelsesområde for Jordbaseret Luftforsvar ved Flyvestation Tirstrup   Brænder du for at udvikle komplekse organisationer, skabe motiverede teams og omsætte visioner til handling? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som leder af Vedligeholdelsesområde Vest ved Flyvestation Tirstrup, hvor du får en central rolle i områdets etablering og udvikling.   Om os   Danmarks nye Jordbaserede Luftforsvar er en af Forsvarets helt nye og mest avancerede materielkapaciteter. Kapaciteten, der er placeret på Flyvestation Tirstrup og Flyvestation Skalstrup ved Roskilde, har afgørende betydning for styrkelsen af det danske luftforsvar, Forsvarets generelle kampkraft og Danmarks sikkerhed.  Forsvarets Vedligeholdelsestjeneste kommer til at spille en central rolle i opbygning såvel som i drift og vedligeholdelse af det Jordbaserede Luftforsvar. Dette indebærer blandt andet opbygning af nye værkstedskapaciteter i både øst- og vest Danmark.  Vi er en kvalitetsledelses- og arbejdsmiljøbevidst servicevirksomhed, hvis vigtigste opgave er at sikre, at Forsvarets materiel er pålideligt og altid klar til kamp. Som værnsfælles myndighed har vi højt specialiserede værksteder fordelt i hele Danmark, der servicerer, vedligeholder og modificerer alt fra kampvogne til helikoptere, kanoner og langtrækkende luftforsvarssystemer.  Vi består desuden af en Planlægnings- og Koordinationsdivision med geografisk placering i Brabrand, Aarhus. I alt beskæftiger myndigheden cirka 1700 medarbejdere og udlåner herudover fagligt militært personel til Forsvarets operative enheder og operationer.   Om stillingen   Som leder af Vedligeholdelsesområdet, Jordbaseret Luftforsvar på Flyvestation Tirstrup, får du ansvaret for at:    Forvalte og optimere forsyningskæden og vedligeholdelsen  Sikre rettidig tilgængelighed af varer og materiel  Sikre opgaver udføres i overensstemmelse med områdets mål og gældende krav til effektiv, sikker og kvalitetsmæssig korrekt drift  Sikre effektiv gennemførelse af vedligeholdelsesarbejdet og kvaliteten i leverancerne  Varetage organisatorisk udvikling, strukturelle tilpasninger og transformationer  Sikre motivation, performance og gode resultater i Vedligeholdelsesområdet  Lede og udvikle områdets medarbejdere og deres kompetencer  Sikre overholdelse og optimering af bestemmelser, direktiver, interne politikker og procedurer  Optimere på ressourceanvendelsen og omkostningerne  Understøtte Vedligeholdelsesområdets strategiske og operationelle mål  Tage aktivt ansvar for løsning af incidents/major incidents    Da vi er i en opbygningsfase, vil du indledningsvis være med til at opbygge kapaciteten og kompetencerne for Vedligeholdelsesområde, så vi møder de operative- og planlægningsmæssige milepæle. I denne fase vil du således skulle bidrage aktivt og med initiativ til etableringen i samarbejde med det Jordbaserede Luftforsvars ledelse.   Om dig   Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant teknisk baggrund og erfaring. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfarin

title: Client Excellence Lead

title: [flex] Account Management Lead
description: 플렉스팀의 Account Management Lead는 Account Management 팀을 이끌며, 고객 유지와 확장 성장 전반을 책임지는 리더입니다.      AM팀은 성격이 다른 두 고객 테리토리를 담당합니다.        하나는 Mid-Market 이상 규모의 Key Account로, 제품을 중심으로 복잡한 이해관계자 구조 속에서 데이터 기반으로 고객 여정을 설계하고 갱신·확장을 리딩해야 하는 고객군입니다.     다른 하나는 조직 규모는 SMB지만 HR Partners/Payroll Partners 등 People Service가 결합되어 대표·C-level과 직접 소통하며 복합 서비스 계약을 비즈니스 관점에서 조율해야 하는 고객군입니다.       AM Lead는 규모와 계약 구조, 요구 역량이 전혀 다른 이 두 테리토리를 깊이 이해하고, 하나의 팀 전략과 일관된 운영 체계로 통합해내는 역할입니다. 단순한 팀 관리를 넘어, 리텐션·확장 매출 목표에 대한 최종 오너십을 갖고 플레이북과 지표 체계를 설계하며, 팀원 개개인이 각자의 테리토리에서 성과를 낼 수 있도록 코칭하며 전략과 실행을 오가는 플레잉 리드로서 주요 고객을 직접 다루는 역할도 함께 수행합니다.         이런 일을 함께 하게 됩니다.      팀 리딩 & 전략     AM 팀의 리텐션, 업셀/크로스셀, 리뉴얼 목표를 설계하고 달성을 책임집니다.    Key Account와 Partners 테리토리 각각의 특성에 맞는 KPI·헬스스코어·운영 지표 체계를 설계하고, NRR 관점에서 팀 성과를 통합 관리합니다.    고객 세그먼트별 플레이북(갱신, 이탈 방어, 업셀/크로스셀 제안)을 표준화하고 지속적으로 고도화합니다.    팀원별 테리토리·어카운트 배분, 목표 설정, 1on1 코칭, 채용을 통해 팀의 성장을 이끕니다.        고객 & 매출 오너십     전사적으로 중요한 Key Account 및 전략 고객을 직접 담당하거나, 주요 갱신·확장 협상에 에스컬레이션 파트너로 참여합니다.    이탈 리스크 시그널을 팀 차원에서 조기에 식별하는 체계를 만들고, 대응 전략의 실행을 리딩합니다.    복잡한 계약 구조(제품 + People Service 조합, 가격 정책, 리뉴얼 조건)에 대한 협상 기준과 가이드를 수립합니다.        크로스펑셔널 협업     Implementation Team에서 온보딩을 마친 고객을 AM 팀이 안정적으로 인계받는 핸드오프 체계를 정비하고 운영합니다.    Product, CXM, Partners Service(HR/Payroll), Sales 등 유관 조직과의 협업 구조를 설계하고, 고객 인사이트가 제품·서비스 개선으로 이어지는 루프를 만듭니다.    고객 데이터(MRR, 사용률, 헬스스코어, 계약 구조)를 기반으로 경영진에 리텐션·확장 현황과 전략을 보고합니다.          이런 분과 함께 하고 싶습니다.       B2B SaaS 또는 IT 서비스 업계에서 풍부한 Account Management / Customer Success / Sales 경험을 갖고 계신 분     리텐션·NRR·확장 매출 등 정량 목표에 대한 최종 오너십을 갖고 팀 단위 성과를 만들어본 분    서로 다른 고객 테리토리(Mid-Market 이상, SMB)를 동시에 운영하거나, 테리토리 설계·배분을 직접 해본 경험이 있는 분    헬스스코어, 이탈 지표 등 데이터 기반으로 고객 운영 체계를 만들고, 플레이북으로 팀에 정착시켜본 분    대표·C-level 등 최고 의사결정자와의 협상과, 실무~의사결정자에 걸친 복잡한 이해관계자 관리 모두에 능숙한 분    플레잉 리드로서 직접 고객을 다루는 것과 팀을 통해 성과를 내는 것 사이의 균형을 잡을 수 있는 분    제품, 서비스 운영, 고객지원 등 유관 조직과 협업 구조를 설계하고 조율해본 분          이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋겠습니다.       HR SaaS 또는 HR/Payroll 도메인에 대한 이해가 있는 분    제품과 운영 서비스(BPO, 컨설팅, 매니지드 서비스)가 결합된 비즈니스 모델을 경험해본 분    체계가 잡힌 조직에서 AM/CS 팀을 운영해본 경험이 있고, 검증된 운영 체계(목표 관리, 코칭, 평가 등)를 성장 단계의 조직에 맞게 이식할 수 있는 분    복잡한 계약 구조(멀티 프로덕트, 서비스 조합, 갱신 조건)의 협상을 직접 리딩해본 분    Salesforce, Pipedrive 등 CRM 기반의 세일즈/CS 운영 체계를 구축해본 분          합류 여정을 안내드립니다       서류 전형 >  Pre-Interview(화상)> Job Interview > Peer Interview > Fit Interview > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 순서로 진행됩니다.

description: HITO is New Zealand’s largest industry training organisation for hairdressing, barbering and beauty. HITO apprentices learn on the job, in salons, barbershops and clinics, the length of the country, and our Sales and Training Advisors are the people who make that happen —Build relationships with employers, meet sales targets, set training plans, and support apprentices through their qualification journey. Key responsibilities    Support STA business development by working with individual STAs and their regions to identify ways to increase learner enrolments and work with Marketing on collateral and communications as required  Monitor regional and national KPIs including new enrolments, learner retention, completion rates.  Collaborate with other department managers to resolve operational issues and improve service  Lead and coach and mentor STAs on sales skills, pastoral care, and account management  Work directly with Corporate Services staff, such as Finance, Marketing and Industry Support to address concerns from industry stakeholders.  Provide back-up for Advisors on leave to ensure stakeholders are provided with timely actions and services  Provide account management for HITO key employers and growth accounts as required  Represent HITO at national events such as Graduation, Awards ceremonies and conventions as required.       About you    Experience in sales and business development, preferably in an education environment  Ability to develop strong and lasting relationships efficiently and effectively internally and externally  Knowledge and understanding of work-based training or tertiary education, desirable  Knowledge and understanding of employers in hairdressing, beauty therapy or barbering industries  Experience managing people, and a genuine appetite for developing a team  Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills  A track record of managing KPIs and targets  Excellent relationship management and team skills      Whilst this position is advertised as Wellington based, we are open to this position being located outside of the Wellington region for the right candidate with travel into the Wellington Office when needed.     This is a full-time, fixed term position for 12 months, with a possibility of becoming permanent.

We are passionate about accelerating medical advancements and improving patient outcomes.    Our team comprises seasoned clinical research professionals, data scientists, and AI experts, working collaboratively to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world clinical needs.    With an unwavering commitment to revolutionize healthcare, we envision a world where all patients benefit from accelerated and cost-effective access to treatments. Biorce is poised to redefine the landscape of healthcare, shaping a future where innovation and accessibility converge for the betterment of humanity.   About the role    As our  Head of Product Success , you will lead the global organization responsible for ensuring Biorce customers successfully adopt, scale, and realize value from our technology.  This is a senior leadership role overseeing a  30-person Product Success organization across Barcelona and Austin . You will own the strategy, structure, performance, development, and continued scaling of the function as Biorce rapidly expands its technology, customer base, and global footprint.  Reporting directly to the  VP of Product Success , you will sit at the intersection of our customers, Product, Engineering, and Commercial organizations. title: Ekonom med intresse för system och kundrelationer
description: Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.     Om tjänsten   Som Professional Services Specialist hos oss är du en  nyckelperson för våra kunder.  Din huvudsakliga uppgift är att säkerställa en framgångsrik onboarding och hjälpa kunderna att få ut maximalt värde av våra produkter. Du kommer bli specialist inom en rad områden som exempelvis koncernkonsolidering, rapportering och finansiell analys. Du kommer få tillfälle att arbeta med många bolag och koncerner inom olika branscher och storlekar med varierande komplexitet. Målet är att du, genom din expertis, hjälper dem att ta fram ett bra underlag för deras beslut och analyser.  Dina dagar kommer att vara fyllda med kundmöten, främst online, där du onboardar och stöttar våra kunder i våra produkter. Du kommer även:    Hålla i utbildningsforum för större byråer med många konsulter.  Agera expertstöd till säljorganisationen vid workshops och demonstrationer.  Samarbeta tätt med våra produktchefer och utvecklare genom att testa nya funktioner och rapportera eventuella buggar.  Vara en viktig länk mellan kunden och vår interna organisation.      Om dig   Vi tror att du har en stark grund inom ekonomi, antingen via utbildning eller tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet.  Du trivs i en konsultativ roll  där du får kombinera din ekonomiska expertis med ett stort intresse för kundvård och teknik. Du är lugn, pedagogisk och har en förmåga att anpassa dig efter olika kunders behov. För att lyckas ser vi gärna att du har:    En utbildning inom ekonomi eller motsvarande.  Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet från en roll som exempelvis controller, redovisningsassistent, ekonom, ekonomiassistent eller liknande.  Ett stort intresse för att bygga relationer och förstå kundens behov.  En teknisk nyfikenhet och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya system.      Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet    Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.     Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.    Välkommen med din ansökan!    Behandling av personuppgifter   Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Perso

I direkte samarbejde med CTO er du med til at styrke sikkerheden i afdelingens arbejdsgange og følge op på aftalte forbedringer. Tage ejerskab for teststrategi, testplanlægning og den løbende forbedring of vores kvalitetssikring  Sikre et godt samspil mellem manuel, automatiseret og scriptbaseret test.  Skabe overblik over testresultater og kvalitetsrisici i forbindelse med releases.  Lede og udvikle testteamet og samarbejde tæt med udviklerne om at forebygge fejl.  Varetage opgaver inden for informationssikkerhed i udviklingsafdelingen.       Din baggrund   Du har solid og bred erfaring med softwaretest og ved, hvordan man både opbygger og udfører en testindsats, der fungerer i praksis. Du har også prøvet at være leder med personaleansvar. Det behøver ikke være gennem mange år, men du skal have lyst til at udvikle dig som leder og tage ansvar for andre.     Erfaring med maskinstyringssystemer er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder erfaring med test af Android-applikationer og kendskab til informationssikkerhed i et udviklingsmiljø.      Det er virkelig fedt, hvis du    Arbejder systematisk og kan prioritere test ud fra risiko og betydning for brugeren  Har forståelse for både manuel test og mulighederne i testautomatisering  Er en nærværende leder, der giver tydelig

description: Vil du tage ansvar for en omfattende IT-modernisering og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretning, processer og teknologi? Metz er en familieejet virksomhed med omkring 60 medarbejdere. Gennem mange år har virksomheden udviklet systemer og arbejdsgange, der understøtter forretningen, men som i dag også skaber kompleksitet og afhængigheder.  Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central anvendes allerede til økonomistyring, mens Lotus Notes fortsat understøtter centrale processer inden for blandt andet lager, CRM og projektstyring.     Nu skal systemlandskabet moderniseres med ambitionen om mere sammenhængende, effektive og fremtidssikrede løsninger.  Du kommer ikke ind til et færdigt projekt med en fastlagt plan. Du skal være med til at skabe planen – og sikre, at den bliver gennemført.  Din rolle  Som IT-projektleder får du ansvaret for at planlægge, prioritere og drive det samlede transformationsprogram. Du skal sikre sammenhæng og fremdrift på tværs af projekterne og selvstændigt vurdere behovet for indsatser og kompetencer undervejs.     Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:   Kortlægge forretningsprocesser, systemer, integrationer og dataflows.  Indsamle og strukturere input fra forretningen og omsætte behov til konkrete systemkrav og næste skridt.  Bidrage til valg og samspil mellem ERP, CRM, lagerstyring og øvrige systemer.  Udarbejde og drive et samlet roadmap med prioriteringer, tidsplaner, ressourcer, budgetter og risici.  Drive projekterne gennem datamigrering, test, brugeraccept, idriftsættelse og overdragelse til drift.  Tage ejerskab for eksterne leverandører, koordinere interne interessenter og sikre kommunikation, oplæring og forankring.      Du skal kunne bevæge dig fra en workshop med lageret om deres daglige arbejdsgange til en teknisk dialog med en systemleverandør – og samtidig sikre, at projekterne kommer i mål.  Hvem er du?  Du har solid erfaring med IT-projektledelse eller transformationsledelse, gerne fra større ERP-implementeringer eller digitale transformationer, som du har været med til at drive fra start til slut.     Du forstår både teknologi og forretning og ved, at succesfulde IT-projekter handler lige så meget om mennesker og processer som om systemer.  Metz lægger især vægt på, at du:   Har dokumenteret erfaring med komplekse IT-projekter og gerne samlede transformationsprogrammer.  Har god forståelse for ERP, systemarkitektur, integrationer og dataflows.  Kan analysere forretningsprocesser og omsætte behov til konkrete løsninger.  Har erfaring med projektøkonomi, leverandørstyring og forandringsledelse.  Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og skaber fremdrift, også når ikke alle svar ligger klar.      Erfaring med Business Central, CRM, WMS eller PIM er en fordel, men ikke et krav.  Metz søger ikke

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Location Requirement: Washington, D.C. metro area strongly preferred; other major federal markets considered.

Travel: Up to 60-75%, including customer, partner, and industry/policy engagements across the federal market.

About the Role

Veeam is expanding its Federal go-to-market strategy in advance of FedRAMP authorization, targeted by the end of calendar year 2026. The Principal Systems Engineer, Federal will serve as Veeam’s Federal Principal Technologist, acting as a technical evangelist and trusted advisor across the U.S. Public Sector.

This is not a traditional presales role. Operating ahead of the pipeline, you will engage agency executives, policy leaders, systems integrators, industry partners, analysts, and media to build technical credibility and cultivate champions who will help accelerate demand as Veeam’s federal business scales. Success in this role requires deep expertise in data protection, cyber resilience, and security, along with the executive presence to influence CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and mission leaders.

As the public face of Veeam’s federal technology strategy, you will evangelize the company’s four strategic pillars: Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data & AI Trust, and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). You will translate Veeam’s platform vision and DataAI Command Platform into compelling narratives that resonate with civilian, DoD, and intelligence community stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Market & Technical Evangelism — Serve as Veeam's principal federal technical voice at industry events, agency briefings, partner forums, analyst engagements, and policy roundtables, articulating Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data and AI Trust, and DSPM in terms that resonate with government audiences.
  • Executive & Policy Engagement — Build and maintain trusted relationships with agency C-level technology leaders (CIO/CISO/CTO), acquisition and policy leads, and mission owners, positioning Veeam's architecture and roadmap against their compliance, resilience, and modernization priorities.

description:

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

title: Regional Sales Director, Nordics (Sweden)
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is seeking a Regional Sales Leader to help us build and grow the Kong API platform and our Strategic Sales Team in the Nordics. We are searching for a seasoned industry leader who will lead our Enterprise Account Executives and drive business results and revenue. Reporting to the RVP of Northern EMEA, this senior leadership position will have ownership and accountability to ensure Kong maximizes our market potential bringing in new customers as well as growing our existing clients.

This leader will work closely with our other senior leaders to ensure decisions are driving the overall Kong business goals and our long term vision continues to thrive. You will play a part in reshaping and leading the incredible growth of Kong. It is the intention of the leadership team to build a high quality, sustainable and strong sales organization. To date, a significant amount of Kong’s success has been gained through the quality of our product, our global account base, our adoption by the open source community and by inbound leads.

You will build and strengthen a quality, scalable, regional sales team focused on acquisition of new brands and targeted account plans. Kong is the perfect environment for you to have a significant impact and grow our amazing company. We are a people first organization and expect you to be the same.

What You’ll Do:

  • Growing Kong’s presence and footprint in Strategic accounts in Nordics.

  • Driving a highly performant and highly accountable culture to achieve and exceed sales goals

  • Attract, hire and retain top talent through your network and in collaboration with the rest of the org

  • Provide strong coaching and mentorship on the sales process, PG, qualification and closing

  • Conduct weekly forecast meetings with your team and report to leadership

  • Collaborate effectively with Marketing, Partners, and all stakeholders

What You’ll Bring:

  • You have been a top performer as an IC and front-line manager with a track record of overachievement

  • Accurate forecasting at the individual and team levels

  • Ability to recruit, develop, and retain top talent

  • Strong territory management at a regional level

  • Proven systems/methodology for consistent pipeline generation

  • Experience using and teaching sales methodologies

  • Energy, passion, and rigour in your career as a Sales leader

title: Field Sales Development Representative
description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***

We are looking for a Field Sales Development Representative (FSDR) to play a crucial role in capturing and qualifying leads at events and remotely via phone and email. You will be the face of Roofr at industry trade shows, conferences, and local events, engaging with potential customers, showcasing our solutions, and ensuring a seamless handoff to our sales team.

What You’ll Get to Do:

75% of time remote/25% at events

  • Learn about Roofr, our industry and competitors, and our value proposition
  • Execute a high number of daily activities (Calls, emails, social selling, etc.)
  • Attend roofing industry events, trade shows, and conferences to generate leads
  • Conduct on-the-spot helicopter demos showcasing Roofr’s value proposition
  • Drive revenue growth by connecting with roofing professionals in the field Work partner-referred leads inside a defined speed-to-lead SLA — first touch within minutes, not hours
  • Connect with and qualify inbound leads
  • Build and establish rapport with multiple levels of buyers
  • Understand the prospect's needs and effectively communicate how Roofr will help
  • Partner with Roofr Partner Reps and Account Executives and collaborate on how to hand off qualified sales opportunities
  • Own demo attendance: confirm before the call, chase no-shows the same day, and re-book or re-qualify rather than letting them go cold
  • Track and improve your own booked-to-attended conversion rate
  • Document vario

title: Sales Lead - Government
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

title: Customer Sales Engineer
description:
Who are we?
At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

At UpGuard, our Sales team continues to be the engine of our growth, moving beyond simple transactions to become trusted architects of digital resilience. In an era where third-party risk is more complex than ever, we maintain a highly collaborative, consultative culture that puts the customer’s security posture above all else.

Following a record-breaking 2025 where we shattered revenue targets and expanded our global footprint, we are entering 2026 with even greater momentum. We are seeking high-energy individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, AI-augmented sales environment. If you are hungry to sharpen your craft, possess a relentless desire to win, and want to sell a platform that is actively neutralising global cyber threats, we want to talk to you.

Where does this role fit in?
 
We are looking for a dynamic, customer-facing Customer Sales Engineer to be the primary technical and product expert for our Account Management team. The primary focus of this role is to support customer expansion by partnering with Account Managers during complex renewal and upsell opportunities.
 
You will be the go-to expert for our new multi-product offering, responsible for demonstrating advanced technical value and architecting solutions that drive growth within our existing customer base.
 
This role is perfect for someone who excels in a post-sales technical environment, loves being a product authority, and thrives on building solutions that directly impact commercial success.

Your mandate is to move the needle on demand generation across the entire marketing funnel, while raising the standard for how analytical work gets produced, challenged, and shipped across the org.

title: Field & Event Marketing Manager, APAC (Singapore)
description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Team Overview

Deepgram recently opened its APAC headquarters in Singapore, and the region is one of our fastest-moving markets. You’ll build the APAC marketing function from zero, partnering closely with the APAC GM and regional sales leadership to shape and execute the regional plan. As part of the global Events & Field Marketing team, you’ll get the playbooks, brand assets, budget framework and coaching to help you move fast.

Your job is to make Deepgram visible and credible across the region through technical community and partner motions, and to turn that presence into pipeline. As the senior marketer in region, you're also marketing's local point of contact: you'll work with our APAC PR agency and partner with global Brand, Web, and Product Marketing to keep regional messaging local and consistent.

Key Goals

  • Ship an APAC field and events plan and budget, agreed with regional sales

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B.

We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.

About the Role:

YipitData is the leading alternative data platform for institutional investors, giving hedge funds and asset managers the differentiated insights they need to make better investment decisions. We are a multi-modal platform, inclusive of data feeds, our Investor Portal, and AI-powered agents and MCPs, that are redefining how investors discover, analyze, and act on data.

Product Marketing sits at the intersection of Product and Revenue, ensuring what we build, how we position it, and how we sell it are tightly aligned. As we expand into AI-native workflows, this function plays a critical role in shaping how our platform is understood, launched, and sold to increasingly sophisticated buyers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own that work for our Public Investor segment. You'll define positioning, lead product launches, and enable our commercial teams to bring the next generation of investor workflows to market. This is a foundational role with real scope, building core PMM capabilities for one of our most critical business lines. If you want to define how the future of investor workflows is understood and sold, this is your role.

Key Responsibilities of the Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • Own product positioning and go-to-market strategy for a new generation of AI and big data products, shaping how investors understand and adopt data feeds, the Investor Portal and AI-powered solutions like agents and MCPs
  • Define ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and tailoring messaging to different investor segments (e.g., hedge funds vs. long-onlys)

You act as the primary business partner for your customers, drive customer success, project delivery, retention, cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the Aryza suite.   Your contribution    Key Account Management     Own and manage a portfolio of strategic customer accounts.  Develop executive and operational stakeholder relationships.  Conduct regular business reviews and account planning sessions.  Ensure customer retention and long-term partnership growth.  Act as primary escalation point and trusted advisor.     Commercial Growth & Business Development     Identify and develop cross-sell and upsell opportunities.  Support contract renewals and commercial discussions.  Maintain account growth plans and customer roadmaps.  Collaborate with Sales and Product teams to position additional solutions.  Contribute to revenue growth targets.     Project & Programme Management     Lead implementation, upgrade and transformation projects.  Manage plans, timelines, budgets, risks and resources.  Coordinate internal and customer stakeholders.  Provide structured reporting and governance.  Ensure successful delivery within scope, time and budget.     Customer Success & Service Management     Coordinate service improvements and escalations.  Monitor service performance and customer satisfaction.  Drive adoption and business value realization.  Represent customer requirements internally.     What Makes You Stand Out     5+ years of account management, customer success or project management experience.  Experience in SaaS, software or technology environments.  Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.  Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.  Knowledge of Agile, Scrum or PRINCE2 methodologies.     Have we sparked your interest?   Can you see yourself in this role? Then we’d love to get to know you! Please send us your CV and a short cover letter, along with your earliest possible start date and your salary expectations.   About Us    One team, one purpose  We believe in working closely together towards a shared vision.  At Aryza we are a global family. We encourage teams to unleash their potential by building tools that genuinely help improve the financial situation of people and businesses around the world. If you are interested in what’s next, we’re looking for people who believe that we can accomplish so much more together than apart.  Get in touch and join our amazing team!

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: At Blue Light Card, our mission is to support and celebrate those who serve communities with unwavering dedication - from emergency services to healthcare, defence, and education sectors. By offering exclusive benefits and discounts through partnerships with top brands, we aim to make a meaningful impact on their everyday lives.  Founded in the UK in 2008, we now have more than 6 million members globally. We launched in Australia in 2022 with the same commitment to supporting those who serve. This is an opportunity to be part of a team driving the next chapter of Blue Light Card’s journey, blending purpose with measurable commercial success.  We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the member journey from first sign-up through to retention and reactivation, and make it one of our biggest growth levers.   The role:   This role combines strategy and technical delivery. You’ll set the lifecycle strategy and build it yourself in Braze. Your focus is getting members to sign up faster, use their card more often and stay active. You’ll report to our Head of Engagement and lead and develop a Marketing Coordinator. This one is essential.   • Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker and Linux

  • Solid understanding of GDPR and personal data

Nice to have

  • ROS 2, MCAP or LeRobot; annotation or dataset management tools

  • Kubernetes or SLURM; basic ML training workflows in PyTorch

Your mission

description:
Wer wir sind und was wir suchen

Ob die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich. 

Das Dezernat Zukunft ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. Geleitet von den Werten Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte. 

In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht.

  • Du analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte. Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau. 
  • Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen K

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

title: (Senior) Performance Consultant (m/w/d) - Paid Social
description:
Dein Mission

Du schaust dir Ads im Feed genauer an als die meisten Menschen, und bei Suchanzeigen oder Display-Kampagnen geht es dir genauso? Du weißt, wann ein Euro bei Meta besser angelegt ist als bei Google oder in einer programmatischen Buchung? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Wir suchen eine Expertin oder einen Experten für digitale Kampagnen, deren Herz für Paid Social schlägt und die Programmatic, SEA und Werbung in KI-Umgebungen sicher mitdenken. Jemanden, der unsere Kunden und unser Team mit Wissen, Selbstbewusstsein und Begeisterung mitnimmt.


Deine Rolle

  • Du entwickelst Full-Funnel-Strategien für digitale Kampagnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Meta (Facebook, Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn und YouTube. Dazu kommen Programmatic, SEA und neue Werbeumfelder in KI-Assistenten und KI-gestützter Suche (Generative Engine Advertising).
  • Du planst den Media Mix und verteilst Budgets so über die Kanäle, dass sie auf die Business-Ziele unserer Kunden einzahlen.
  • Du konzipierst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen mit hohen sechsstelligen Budgets. Dazu gehören komplexe Zielgruppen-Setups, A/B-Tests von Creatives, Gebotsstrategien und die Steuerung von Keywords und Placements.
  • Du bringst Creator- und Influencer-Content gezielt in die Paid Ausspielung, etwa über Meta Partnership Ads und TikTok Spark Ads. Mit Creators und Content-Teams stimmst du ab, welche Inhalte sich als Anzeige eignen und wie sie getestet werden.
  • Für App-Kunden planst und steuerst du App-Kampagnen über Meta, TikTok und Google App Campaigns , von der Installation bis zur In-App-Conversion.
  • Du sorgst für saubere Daten: Conversions API, serverseitiges Tracking und eine Messung, der der Kunde vertrauen kann.
  • Du analysierst in den nativen Plattform-Tools, in GA4 und in Looker Studio. Du kannst zeigen, welcher Kanal welchen Beitrag leistet und leitest daraus klare Empfehlungen ab, die du souverän beim Kunden präs

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

Our Data Scientists and AI/ML Engineers build AI solutions. You make them usable for everyone at EDRI. As a Full-Stack AI Engineer in our newly established AI UNIT within E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), a special unit built and run like a startup, you will build the internal platform that makes AI solutions accessible to hundreds of colleagues across EDRI. You will work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration, taking full ownership from the initial architecture to reliable operation in production. Where this is heading: every colleague builds their own applications with AI coding tools, while login, backend, security, and hosting are set up automatically – and you design it. You report to our Head of AI Strategy. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Build our internal AI platform from scratch and develop it into one central place for all AI solutions
  • Design a modular architecture that allows new AI solutions to be integrated and launched quickly
  • Develop intuitive frontends, including conversational, generative, and streaming interfaces
  • Build backend services and APIs, integrating models and services developed by our AI/ML Engineers
  • Implement authentication, role management, access controls, and secure system integrations – security by design
  • Ensure scalability and performance for hundreds of users and millions of requests through load testing, caching, and continuous optimization

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

You turn data into decisions for a pan-European business. As a Senior Data Scientist in our newly established AI UNIT within E.ON Drive Infrastructure (EDRI), a special unit built and run like a startup, you will help transform complex business challenges into data-driven decisions. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will develop analyses, experiments, and models that create measurable business impact and shape the future of AI-driven decision-making at EDRI. You report to our Head of AI Strategy. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Translate business challenges into analyses, predictive models, and actionable recommendations
  • Build and validate statistical, machine learning, and optimization models to support strategic decision-making
  • Design experiments and measure real business impact, beyond correlation, using rigorous analytical methodologies
  • Collaborate with AI/ML Engineers to bring analytical models into production environments
  • Communicate insights, assumptions, and uncertainty clearly to stakeholders up to CEO level
  • Establish best practices and standards for analytics, experimentation, and model development
  • Evaluate emerging AI models, AI tooling, and agentic systems and use what works to accelerate analysis workflows
  • Drive data-informed decision-making across business functions and regions
  • Share knowledge and support the development of junior colleagues – this is a senior individual contributor role


Your profile

You are a commercially minded Data Scientist who combines strong analytical rigor

Most AI lives in a chat window. Ours will run physical infrastructure across a pan-European network. title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. description:
🌎 What we do

Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.
