title: Solution Engineer - Vehicle OS
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a bright engineer to help our customers solve complex technical problems across Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS portfolio. In this role you will work closely with vehicle software and tooling teams at OEMs and Tier 1s to ensure Applied’s solutions deliver maximum impact in advancing customers’ Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) strategies and in-cabin user experiences.

title: Revenue Operations Manager (HubSpot)
description:
Revenue Operations Manager - HubSpot (w/m/d)

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst das HubSpot-Setup von LIQID weiter: Du baust Workflows, Automationen und Integrationen, die Sales und Relationship Management im Tagesgeschäft unterstützen und machst aus den Daten im System ein Reporting, auf das sich Team und Führung verlassen können.

Den laufenden Betrieb der Plattform hältst du dabei stabil: Berechtigungen, Lizenzen, Datenqualität, Dokumentation. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt jedoch auf dem Bauen, nicht auf dem Verwalten.

System und Team

HubSpot Sales Hub und Service Hub sind in diesem Jahr frisch implementiert. Du triffst also kein fertiges System an, das verwaltet werden will, sondern eine Plattform im Aufbau. Entsprechend groß sind der Gestaltungsspielraum und die Verantwortung für saubere Grundlagen.

Du berichtest an den Lead Revenue Operations und arbeitest eng mit Sales und Relationship Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Baue Workflows, Sequences, Pipelines und Lead Routing in HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub: von der Verteilung eingehender Leads über Meeting-Links bis zu automatischen Aufgaben in Sales und Relationship Management.

  • Übersetze Anforderungen aus Sales und Relationship Management in konkrete HubSpot-Logik und löse wiederkehrende Handarbeit durch Automationen ab.

  • Kollaboriere mit unserem Data Team bezüglich Datenaustausch und -aufbereitung zwischen den relevanten Kernsystemen.

  • Verbinde HubSpot mit dem übrigen TechStack, also Aircall, Google Workspace, Notion und Slack, über native Connectoren, APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools.

title: Law student / research assistant with focus on data protection
description:
At Oviva, we’re on a mission to make sustainable, personalized, clinically effective care accessible to everyone as we build Europe’s leading AI-powered chronic care platform. Our digital programmes help people manage weight-related illnesses by focusing on what matters most: improving health, building confidence, and enhancing quality of life.

To date, we have supported over one million people across the UK, Switzerland, and Germany. Our mission is powered by a dedicated team operating across four countries, including our hub in Poland. Every conversation, coaching session, and line of code brings us closer to a healthier future.

Our journey is accelerating: In 2026, we secured €200 million in Series D funding led by Kinnevik and a group of leading global investors. This investment fuels our next phase of growth, allowing us to scale our AI-enabled chronic care platform across Europe and expand our support to even more people living with chronic conditions.

Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible!

The Role

You will support the legal department in various areas. A focus area is data protection, but it involves other legal work. You will gain valuable insights into the operations of a modern scale-up in a forward-looking industry, as well as exposure to alternative legal career paths in an in-house setting. You can work 100% remotely.

You will help the legal team make sure that all our efforts are compliant and with our patients interest at heart. You will have the opportunity to work hands-on and provide solutions, which will be implemented.

Job responsibilities

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

title: Senior BMS Software Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

In this BMS Software Engineer role, you will join the VÆRIDION Airborne Software team within the Technology division. You will be responsible to lead the design of software required for our propulsion battery management and power distribution for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of the High Voltage Propulsion Battery System at the core of VÆRIDION’s novel propulsion system.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of embedded software for propulsion battery and power distribution from prototypes to future airworthy systems.

  • Implement software development processes and toolchains in compliance with aviation standards and regulations.

  • Define and document software requirements, specifications, and interfaces for the high voltage electrical power system.

  • Collaborate closely with cell, electrical, and thermal engineers to integrate algorithms for battery state estimation, cell balancing, fault detection, power control, and thermal management.

  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of the software, including integration testing with other aircraft systems.

  • Support system integration, iron bird/field testing, and certification efforts, providing expertise on software functionality and performance.

title: Propulsion Design Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies

title: Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

VÆRIDION is a pioneering electric aircraft Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dedicated to revolutionizing regional air mobility and sustainable aviation. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions.

As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team.

Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

We are growing our vascular team and building out the follow-up pathway that sits behind the Neko Body Scan. When a scan raises a vascular flag, such as a low ankle-brachial index, a difference in blood pressure between the arms, or asymmetry on our Spectrum Gen 2 imaging, a member is referred for a follow-up examination. You will carry out those examinations.

This is a senior role within a small, close team. You will scan and report your findings, work closely with our Vascular Specialist, who makes the clinical decisions and referrals, and help shape how the pathway runs as it scales. You will also be a vascular reference point for the doctors and operators who perform first-line measurements in our clinics.

What you will do

  • Perform and report arterial duplex ultrasound of the lower and upper limbs for members referred through the vascular follow-up pathway.

  • Carry out repeat ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI) with Doppler, and toe pressures or toe-brachial index where the pathway calls for them.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

title: Client Account Manager
description: Who We Are   At ZayZoon, we are on a mission to save 10 million hardworking employees 10 billion dollars. We’ve created a financial empowerment platform that helps businesses of all sizes make a big impact on employee financial wellness.  We offer a variety of financial wellness services, like earned wage access, that allows employees to access their earned wages ahead of payday. With 74% of ZayZoon customers reporting reduced financial stress, we know our solutions help lead to happier and more productive employees. ZayZoon was also recognized for its growth in the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 50, 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, and top-10 growth companies in Canada by CIX awards. Our recent funding extension has raised our Series B funding round to nearly $50 million USD 🎉 Join us in shaping the future of employee financial wellness and building services that address the immediate needs of today's employees.  You might see a few cities listed, but no need to be in any of them! We’re fully remote and hire across Canada and the U.S.   About The Role   As a Client Account Manager at ZayZoon, you’ll be the trusted partner for some of our largest and most complex clients. You’ll get to know their business, their people, and what success looks like to them, then help them get the most out of ZayZoon. The work matters: when a client uses ZayZoon well, more of their employees can access their pay when they need it most. You’ll have real ownership over your accounts, a team that has your back, and room to shape how we manage and grow client relationships as we grow.   Your Impact     Be the go-to advisor for a portfolio of high-value clients, connecting what ZayZoon offers to their business goals and the needs of their teams  Grow your accounts by spotting where clients could get more from ZayZoon and building a plan for each one to increase usage and long-term value  Lead business reviews and planning sessions with decision makers to look at results, recognize progress, and find what’s next  Step in when tricky issues come up, including support queries and escalations, rallying the right people internally and seeing things through until the client is taken care of  Bring the client’s voice to Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Care by sharing feedback, testing new offerings, and helping improve how we work  Build lasting partnerships that keep clients with us, keep accounts in good standing, and turn into success stories worth sharing  Help the whole team get better by sharing what works, keeping our resources current, running training sessions, and smoothing out workflows     You Bring     2+ years in a client-facing role where you built relationships, grew accounts, and helped clients get more out of a product  Experience managing your own book of clients, finding upsell opportunities, and working with internal teams to solve problems  A track record of creating and running adoption plans that led to results you can point to  Comfort turn

title: Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager
description:

      URL:   https://6sense.com/ 
 

 
 
 6sense Product Marketing 
 Principal Competitive Intelligence Manager 
 Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss 
  Team:  Product Marketing
 Reports to:  VP, Product Marketing
 Level:  Principal   
 
 About the Role 
 The market we compete in is being redrawn in real time. Point data providers are moving up the stack. Workflow and enrichment tools are repositioning as operating systems. Buyers are assembling their own stacks from components that used to be bought as a platform. Knowing what each competitor shipped last quarter is table stakes — the job is understanding what the pattern means and what we should do about it. 
 This role owns competitive intelligence and win/loss for 6sense. It sits on the Product Marketing team and exists so that our positioning, our roadmap conversations and our field enablement are built on evidence rather than assumption. You will be the person the company turns to when there is a disagreement about why we win, why we lose, and who we are actually competing against. 
 This is a senior individual contributor seat. The work is research, synthesis and judgment — and the willingness to tell the company something it would rather not hear, with the evidence to back it up. 
 
 What You'll Own 
 
 
  The win/loss program, end to end.  Interviews, coding, synthesis and the readouts that go to product and executive leadership. Not administering a program — making it the thing people trust when they disagree. 
 
 
  Competitive positioning and differentiation.  The evidence behind our claims about where we are stronger, and the honesty about where we are not. You partner with the pillar PMMs so competitive insight shapes positioning rather than trailing it. 
 
 
  Structural market analysis.  How buyers are assembling their stacks, where substitution is happening, which categories are converging, and what that means for us eighteen months out. 
 
 
  Field enablement for competitive situations.  Battlecards, objection handling, trap-setting questions and talk tracks that hold up in a live deal rather than in a deck. 
 
 
  Claims discipline for competitive material.  Sourcing every competitive number we put in front of a customer, and saying no to the ones we cannot stand behind. 
 
 
  Competitive monitoring and alerting,  including ownership of the tooling and of what reaches the field versus what stays internal. 
 
 
  Input to roadmap, pricing and packaging, and analyst relations.  Competitive evidence should shape what we build and how we price, not only how we sell. 
 
 
 
 What You'll Bring 
 
 
 8+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing or research-heavy go-to-market roles in B2B SaaS. 
 
 
  Hands-on win/loss experience.  Designing the program, running the interviews and coding the results — not reading someone else's summary. 
 
 
 The ability to run primary research and be honest about what the data does and do

title: Customer Experience Manager - Barselsvikariat
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Camilla Krøyer Jewellery søger en Customer Experience Manager til et barselsvikariat med opstart hurtigst muligt og frem til udgangen af 2027 med mulighed for forlængelse.      Er du passioneret omkring kundeservice, e-commerce og gode kundeoplevelser? Har du naturligt lyst til at tage ansvar, sætte retning og få ting til at ske? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.     Hos Camilla Krøyer Jewellery er vi et lille, ungt og ambitiøst team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen og hjælper hinanden på tværs af vores forskellige områder. Vi går op i at levere en personlig og nærværende kundeoplevelse, samtidig med at vi hele tiden arbejder på at optimere vores processer og måde at arbejde på.      Om stillingen   Som Customer Experience Manager bliver du en central del af vores team og får ansvaret for at drive og udvikle vores kundeserviceoplevelse på tværs af kanaler.      Du kommer blandt andet til at:       Lede og støtte vores Customer Service-team i hverdagen  Sikre, at vores kunder altid får en god, personlig og professionel service  Tage ansvar for den daglige drift og være med til at sætte retningen for teamet  Identificere muligheder for at optimere vores kundeservice og interne processer  Arbejde med e-commerce og vores webshop  Håndtere og løse forskellige kundehenvendelser og udfordringer  Tage initiativ til nye idéer og forbedringer  Sikre et godt samarbejde på tværs af teamet  Hjælpe til, hvor der er behov – også uden for dit primære ansvarsområde  Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra start. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, ivrig, løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage ansvar.       Vi ser at du:       Har erfaring med kundeservice og e-commerce  Har erfaring med at drive eller lede et team, eller har et naturligt talent for at skabe struktur og tage ansvar  Har forståelse for, hvad god kundeservice er, og hvordan man skaber gode kundeoplevelser  Har erfaring med Shopify – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav  Er struktureret og god til at bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt  Er initiativrig og tør komme med idéer og udfordre eksisterende processer  Er open-minded og nysgerrig på nye måder at gøre tingene på  Er god til mennesker og trives med at samarbejde  Er en udpræget holdspiller, som ikke er bange for at give en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det  Snakker flydende dansk, da det har stor betydning for rollen og kunderne       Hvem er vi?   Vi er et lille team med store ambitioner, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når man løfter i flok.     Hos os må man gerne have det sjovt på arbejde, samtidig med at vi tager vores ansvar og vores kunder seriøst. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af opgaver og roller, og derfor er det vigtigt for os, at du trives i et miljø, hvor arbejdsdagen kan være alsidig, og hvor man nogle gange må træde til dér, hvor behovet er størst.     Vi leder efter en person, der har lyst til at blive en del af teamet, tage ansvar og være med til at udvikle både vores kundeservice og kundeoplevelse.

title: Leder du gjennom tillit og gode relasjoner?

title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö, 37.5h/vko, JYSK Rovaniemi
description: Työpaikan kuvaus   Koetko motivoituvasi esihenkilövastuusta, mutta sinulla ei ole vielä kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä?  Meillä ratkaisee asenne ja tavoitteellisuus oppia uutta sekä tehdä tulosta. Meillä apulaismyymäläpäälliköt saavat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden kasvaa. Meillä voit luoda uraa, ja tavoitella tulevaisuudessa omaa myymälää. Jos olet valmiina tarttumaan haasteisiin, tämä voi olla juuri sinun paikkasi.  Tutustu ja lue lisää apulaismyymäläpäällikön työstä JYSKissä.   APULAISMYYMÄLÄPÄÄLLIKÖN TYÖ JYSKISSÄ     Olet vastuussa myymälän myynnillisestä johtamisesta, B2B-myynnistä ja koulutat tiimiä jatkuvasti eri JYSK konseptien tiimoilta.   Tavoitteet ohjaavat työtäsi: meillä jokaisella on selkeä suunta ja halu ylittää odotukset.   Toimit tiiviisti myymäläpäällikön työparina, ja saat vastuullisesi myös esihenkilövastuita ja –tehtäviä.   Toimit hyvänä esimerkkinä koko tiimille, priorisoit ja valtuutat viikoittaisia työtehtäviä tiimin kesken, tuet työvuorosuunnittelussa, huolehdit kampanjavaihdoista, tiimin tiedottamisesta, seuraat tunnuslukuja ja teet tarvittavia toimia sekä pidät huolta että myymälä on aina kaupallinen ja valmiina asiakkaita varten.   Viikoittaisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu myös aktiivinen palautteenantaminen tiimille auttaen heitä onnistumaan työssään.   Työ vaatii hyvää peruskuntoa, mutta saat käyttöösi parhaat työvälineet ja tiimin tuen.   Monipuolisuutta – myymälä, varasto, kampanjat… tylsyys ei kuulu sanavarastoomme.      MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA     Sinulla on motivaatiota tehdä töitä esihenkilönä ja johtaa tiimiä tuloksiin omalla esimerkilläsi.   Kokemus ja näytöt esimerkiksi vuorovastaavan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä.   Olet myyntihenkinen, ja tuloksellisuus sekä tavoitteiden ylittäminen ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita työssäsi. Haluat myös myydä ja menestyä joka työvuorossa.   Tunnet muiden kouluttamisen, perehdyttämisen ja opastamisen osaksi omia vahvuuksiasi.   Siedät keskeneräisyyttä, koska tekemistä on paljon ja kaikkea ei aina voi saada valmiiksi kerralla.   Olet parhaimmillasi kiireessä ja nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä. Tykkäät nopeatempoisesta työtahdista ja yllättävistäkin työtehtävistä kesken työvuoron. title: Koboジャパン事業部 カスタマーエクスペリエンス課：カスタマーケアマネージャー
description: Job Description    楽天・事業について   楽天グループのミッションは、「イノベーションを通じて、人々と社会に力を与えること」です。  楽天Koboは、グループのグローバルなデジタル読書事業であり、20カ国以上で数百万人の読者に電子書籍、オーディオブック、Kobo電子書籍リーダーを提供しています。日本では、楽天Koboは国内最大級の電子書籍ストアの一つを運営しており、電子書籍リーダーのラインナップも拡大を続けています。  ※数字でみる楽天の事業  https://corp.rakuten.co.jp/careers/services/   部署・サービスについて   Kobo Japanのカスタマーケアチームは、電子書籍の購入、アカウント、アプリ、電子書籍リーダー端末に関するお問い合わせに対し、電話、メール、チャットを通じて日本の読者の皆様をサポートしています。サポート業務は、東京にある社内チームが、提携コールセンターおよびAIチャットボットと連携して行っています。当チームは、ツール、KPI、ベストプラクティスに関するサポートを提供する、トロントにあるKoboのグローバルカスタマーケアチームと緊密に連携しています。   ポジション：    募集背景   Kobo Japanのカスタマーサポート業務を統括する、実践的なカスタマーケアマネージャーを募集しています。  理想的な候補者は、以下の3つの強みを兼ね備えている方です。  1．コールセンターの外部委託先および社内チームの管理。外部委託先を管理し、社内チームを率いることができます。  2．グローバルな連携。Koboのグローバルカスタマーケアチームと緊密に連携し、共通のツールやプロセスを活用しながら、日本の顧客のニーズを代弁します。  3．KPIおよび測定に関する専門知識。コンタクトセンターの指標を理解し、データを活用して顧客体験の向上を図れる方。  ＜この職務の魅力＞  ・主体性：Koboの主要市場の一つにおいて、カスタマーサポートの全工程にわたり責任を担います。  ・グローバルな環境：トロントやその他の市場のカスタマーケア、プロダクト、エンジニアリング部門の同僚たちと、毎日英語で連携して業務を行います。  ・AIとイノベーション：AIチャットボットや自動化が顧客体験をどのように向上させるかを形作ります。  ・ビジネスへの影響：あなたの顧客インサイトは、ストア、アプリ、デバイスの改善に直接活かされます。   業務内容   ＜ベンダーおよび戦略的リーダーシップ＞  ・パートナーシップ管理：コールセンターパートナーの主な窓口となり、毎月実施する綿密な事業レビューを通じて、SLA、業務KPI、およびブランド基準の厳格な遵守を確保します。  ・チーム育成：社内カスタマーケアチームにおいて、リーダーシップを発揮し、メンタリングを行い、高パフォーマンスな文化を醸成するとともに、専門能力の開発と従業員の定着に注力します。  ・グローバル連携：トロントにあるKoboのグローバルカスタマーケアリーダーシップと緊密に連携し、サポート戦略の推進、ベストプラクティスの共有、および統一されたツールの導入を推進する。  ＜パフォーマンスおよびデータ分析＞  ・KPIの責任：NPS、CSAT、AHT、FCR、QAスコアなどの主要指標におけるパフォーマンス向上を推進する。  ・実用的なインサイト：生データを経営層向けのレポートにまとめ、新たなコンタクトの傾向を特定し、摩擦を軽減するためのプロセス改善を先見的に提案する。  ＜オペレーショナル・エクセレンスと品質＞  ・品質保証：QAフレームワークを統括し、監査結果を活用してコーチングプログラム、社内ナレッジベース、サポートワークフローを改善する。  ・複雑な問題の解決：エスカレーションプロセスを主導し、社内部署間で連携を図り、優先度の高い顧客の問題を効果的に解決する。  ・製品に関する専門知識：トラブルシューティング、保証管理、返品物流など、Kobo eリーダーのエンドツーエンドのサポートを統括する。  ＜イノベーションとコンプライアンス＞  ・デジタルトランスフォーメーション：セルフサービスチャネルおよびAIチャットボットの体験の最適化を主導し、インバウンド対応率と顧客満足度の向上を図る。  ・リスク・コンプライアンス：すべてのサポート業務が、APPI（個人情報保護法）および楽天グループのグローバルポリシーを厳格に遵守するよう確保する。  ・プロセスの最適化：サポートプロセスを継続的に評価・改善し、効率性と顧客体験（CX）全体の向上を図る。   働く環境   ・東京に拠点を置く社内チームが、コールセンターのパートナー企業と連携して業務を行っています。  ・トロントにあるグローバルカスタマーケアチームと緊密に連携しています。時差の関係で、早朝や夜間の会議が時折あります。  ・グローバルチームとのやり取りでは毎日英語を使用します。顧客や現地のパートナーとのやり取りでは日本語を使用します。   必須要件：   ・電話、メール、チャットを扱うコンタクトセンターまたはカスタマーサポート業務において、5年以上の実務経験  ・外部委託のコールセンター業者（BPO）の管理において、2年以上の実務経験  ・社内カスタマーサポートチームの統率経験  ・コンタクトセンターのKPI（NPS、CSAT、AHT、FCR、QA、サービスレベル）の管理および改善における実績  ・海外本社や地域チームとの連携経験（グローバル共通ツールやレポート作成を含む）  ・高度なExcelおよびPowerPointを含む、優れた分析力、レポート作成能力、プレゼンテーション能力  ・カスタマーサービス・チケット管理システム（例：Zendesk、Salesforce Service Cloud、Intercom）の実務知識  ・日本語はネイティブレベル、英語はビジネスレベル。   歓迎要件：   ・AIチャットボットやカスタマーサポートの自動化に関する経験  ・家電製品やデバイス分野におけるカスタマーサポートの経験  ・eコマース、デジタルコンテンツ、またはサブスクリプションサービスに関する経験  ・根本原因分析およびプロセス改善（例：リーン、シックスシグマ、COPC）に関する経験  ・BIツール（例：Tableau、Power BI）の使用経験  ＜求める人物像＞  ・実践的で責任感が強く、高い自律性を持って業務に取り組める方  ・日本語と英語の両方で明確に意思疎通ができる方  ・顧客志向であり、データに基づいた判断ができる方  ・変化や新しいテクノロジーに対して前向きな姿勢をお持ちの方   その他：    勤務地に関する補足   楽天クリムゾンハウス  東京都世田谷区玉川1丁目14-1   関連リンク   ・福利厚生：https://corp.rakuten.co.jp/careers/benefit/  ・募集要項：https://corp.rakuten.co.jp/careers/information/  ・カルチャー：https:

title: Head of Marketplace Experience
description: foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. Job Description    The Head of Marketplace Experience  is a critical leadership role dedicated to optimizing the end-to-end experience for vendors, customers, and riders in the market. You will play a pivotal role in balancing local country requirements with central regional strategies, shaping operational improvements that align with Pandora’s global business goals. Onboarding & Incubation: Ensure all vendor onboarding and incubation operational targets meet high standards of quality, implementing course corrections as needed. title: 글로벌 고객경험(CX) 정책 거버넌스 관리자
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   쿠팡의 CS 조직에 합류하여 고객이 쿠팡에 문의하는 모든 접점에서 일관되고 수준 높은 경험을 제공받을 수 있도록 보장합니다. 해당 포지션은 고객 결과에 영향을 미치는 정책과 프로세스를 총괄 관리하고, 모든 국가/지역에서 우수 사례를 발굴하여 다른 지역으로 전파하며, 고객 경험에 영향을 주는 고객 센터 정책에 대한 최종 결정권을 갖습니다.      업무 내용      정책 및 프로세스 총괄   고객 대면 및 고객 센터 정책의 작성, 검토, 승인, 버전 관리, 폐기에 이르는 전체 프레임워크를 소유하고 운영  지역별 정책 및 프로세스의 단일 현황을 유지 관리하며, 국가별 차이점과 해당 차이가 법률, 시장 또는 고객 요구 사항에 의해 정당화되는지 추적  도입 과정 주도: 당위성을 입증하고, 지역별 팀 간의 조율을 이끌어내며, 최종 완료까지 실행 현황을 추적  정책 의도 대비 실제 고객 결과를 모니터링하고, 정책이 본래 의도한 결과를 내지 못할 때 이를 포착해 문제를 제기      최상의 고객 경험 전파   특정 지역의 우수 고객 경험 사례를 발굴하고, 현지 규제, 비용 및 운영 준비 상태를 고려하여 타 지역 도입 가능성을 평가      최종 의사결정   프로세스 개선(Process Improvements) 팀의 실험을 통해 제안된 정책을 포함하여, 고객 경험에 영향을 미치는 고객 센터 운영 관련 정책의 최종 결정권 보유  일관성을 유지하고 향후 재검토가 가능하도록 각 의사결정의 근거, 배경 데이터, 상충 관계를 문서화      조직 내 얼라인먼트 및 협업   직접적인 지휘 권한이 없는 상황에서도 고객 센터 운영팀, 지역별 CX 리더, 법무·컴플라이언스, 프로덕트, 테크놀로지, 재무 팀 등과의 조율 및 합의를 이끌어냄  정책 운영 일정 관리, 변경 사항 추적, 실행 후속 조치를 수행할 수 있는 팀을 구축, 관리 및 육성       자격   요건       고객 경험 (CX), 고객 센터 운영, 정책, 품질 (QA) 또는 프로세스 거버넌스 분야 8년 이상 경력을 보유하신 분 (인력관리 또는 프로그램 리딩 경력 3년 이상 포함)  규제, 문화 및 운영 방식이 고객 정책에 미치는 영향에 대한 이해도를 바탕으로 한 다국어/다국가 환경에서의 업무 경험이 있으신 분  고객 결과, 비용, 리스크 및 운영 타당성 간의 균형을 맞추며 정책을 결정하고 이를 설득·변호할 수 있는 뛰어난 판단력과 추진력을 보유하신 분  직접적인 권한 없이도 임원급 이해관계자 및 지역별 팀 간의 합의와 얼라인먼트를 이끌어낸 경험이 있으신 분  문의율, 해결률, 환불, 만족도 지표 등 데이터를 활용해 정책 및 프로세스 성과를 평가할 수 있는 역량을 갖추신 분       우대   사항       대규모 이커머스 또는 마켓플레이스 고객 지원 업무 경험이 있으신 분  정책 거버넌스, 품질 보증(QA) 또는 컴플라이언스 프레임워크를 구축하거나 운영한 경험이 있으신 분  비즈니스 영어 회화가 가능하신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.   참고사항 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.    개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/    서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알

title: Serviceleder i POWER
location: Haderslev, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Har du ledelseserfaring? Og kunne du tænke dig en stilling, hvor du får ansvaret for en håndfuld af Danmarks dygtigste servicemedarbejdere i et moderne og vækstende varehus?   ” Som serviceleder har jeg ansvaret for, at mine dygtige medarbejdere skaber tilfredse kunder. Det er vores opgave at lave den perfekte kombination af teknisk support og kundeservice, og det giver mig både en masse spændende udfordringer og en hverdag fuld af glade kunder, ” siger serviceleder Morten Jacobsen.   Velkommen til POWER   Hos POWER lever vi for at yde markedets bedste service. Det skal være en oplevelse at handle hos os, og uanset om vores kunder henvender sig vedrørende køb, rådgivning eller reklamation, så forlader de altid vores butikker med en god oplevelse og et smil på læben.   Tag hånd om service, support og logistik   Du bliver en del af ledergruppen, der udover varehuschefen består af dine 5 lederkolleger. Som serviceleder har du ansvaret for dine medarbejdere, og sammen håndterer I al service, support og logistik i varehuset.  Man finder dig oftest ude på gulvet blandt kunder og kolleger. Det er nemlig her, du sikrer, at dine servicemedarbejdere yder teknisk support kombineret med den bedste kundeservice. Samtidig er det her, du holder gejsten oppe i dit team, da en motiveret og glad medarbejder giver den bedste service.  ” Det er min største opgave at sikre, at kunderne i min butik føler sig hørt og prioriteret. Så det er vigtigt, at mine medarbejdere og jeg altid formår at sætte os i kundens sted. Har en kunde fx behov for en lånecomputer, mens deres egen er til reparation, så gør vi det,”  fortsætter Morten Jacobsen.   Dine ansvarsområder inkluderer at:     Lede, motivere og udvikle erfarne samt nye medarbejdere  varetage returservice og overlevering af produkter til reparation  sikre, at lageret er i ordentlig stand, og at varer til og fra leverandørerne er på plads.  sikre høj grad af teamspirit i afdelingen, samt på tværs af varehuset.     Din udvikling og karriere   En lederstilling hos os er en utrolig mulighed for at rykke dine lederegenskaber op på et endnu højere niveau.  ” Hos POWER tror vi på, at vores medarbejdere altid kan udvikle sig – og det gælder også for dig. Vi er en stor organisation med mange ressourcer og fart over feltet. Derfor er POWER det perfekte sted for dig at udvikle dine kompetencer og blive en leder i verdensklasse, ” siger varehuschef Kim Linneberg.  Drømmer du om at gøre karriere hos POWER, så er denne stilling også et godt springbræt. Som en stor koncern har du mulighed for – på sigt – at bevæge dig på tværs af organisationen. Det kunne fx være i retning af salg eller drift.   Kan du motivere og lede?   Vi ser gerne, at du har ledelseserfaring. Du ved, hvordan du skaber overblik og får sat dine medarbejdere i gang. Du er velkommen til at medbringe dine egne metoder og strukturer inden for ledelse, så længe du driver et motiveret, effektivt og serviceminded team. Og så er du heller ikke bange for at smøge ærmerne

title: Palvelu- / kehityspäällikkö, IT-asiakkuudenhallinta (CRM)
description: Tule mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuden IT-palveluita kanssamme! Tietohallinnon palveluilla on keskeinen rooli sujuvan arjen mahdollistamisessa niin henkilöstöllemme kuin asiakkaillemme. Haemme nyt kokenutta palvelu- / kehityspäällikköä johtamaan IT-asiakkuudenhallinnan tiimiämme ja vastaamaan asiakkuudenhallinnan palvelukokonaisuudesta osana Pihlajalinnan tietohallintoa.      Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Pihlajalinna kehittää asiakaskokemustaan, hyödyntää dataa liiketoiminnan päätöksenteossa sekä ottaa käyttöön uusia digitaalisia ja tekoälyyn perustuvia toimintamalleja.      💡 Millaisesta työstä on kyse?      Palvelu- / kehityspäällikkönä vastaat Pihlajalinnan asiakkuudenhallinnan palvelukokonaisuuden toimivuudesta, kehittämisestä ja kustannustehokkuudesta. Toimit Salesforce-alustan omistajana sekä ohjaat sen kehitystä ja arkkitehtuurin suuntaa yhteistyössä liiketoiminnan ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Samalla johdat pääasiassa konsulteista koostuvaa IT-asiakkuudenhallinnan tiimiä ja vastaat sen osaamisen, resurssien sekä työhyvinvoinnin kehittämisestä.     Roolissasi johdat asiakkuudenhallinnan kehityksen tiekarttaa ja priorisointia sekä viet liiketoiminnan tarpeita toteutettaviksi kehityskohteiksi. Kehität asiakas- ja potilaskokemusta tukevia toimintamalleja sekä datan laatua, raportointia ja analytiikkaa. Vastuullesi kuuluvat myös palvelualueen budjetointi, kustannusseuranta sekä toimittaja- ja sopimushallinta. Tehtävässä varmistat, että asiakkuudenhallinnan kehitys tukee Pihlajalinnan strategisia tavoitteita ja tuottaa mitattavaa liiketoimintahyötyä.     Palvelu- / kehityspäällikkönä johdat merkittäviä käyttöönottoja ja muutoksia sekä tuet liiketoiminnan pääkäyttäjäverkostoa uusien ratkaisujen käyttöönotossa ja hyödyntämisessä. Tekoäly on yksi asiakkuudenhallinnan kehittämisen painopisteistä. Tehtävässä mahdollistat myös agenttipohjaisten tekoälyratkaisujen hallitun käyttöönoton sekä kehität niitä tukevia toimintamalleja ja hallintakäytäntöjä. Huolehdit yhteistyössä tietosuojan ja tietoturvan asiantuntijoiden kanssa siitä, että asiakas- ja potilastietojen käsittely täyttää sille asetetut vaatimukset.     Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä liiketoimintajohdon, myynnin, markkinoinnin, asiakaspalvelun, tietohallinnon muiden palvelualueiden sekä ulkoisten kumppaneiden kanssa. Johdat toimittaja- ja sopimushallintaa sekä kehität yhteistyötä alusta-, integraatio- ja toteutuskumppaneiden kanssa.     Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Tehtävässä voit työskennellä Tampereella tai Helsingissä, ja työ sisältää kattavat etätyömahdollisuudet sekä joustavan työajan.       ❤️ Unelmien työpaikka Pihlajalinnassa? title: Service Manager
location: Mount Maunganui, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand
description: Farmer Autovillage  is seeking an experienced and motivated  Service Manager  to lead its busy multi-brand service department in  Mount Maunganui.   This is an excellent opportunity for an established automotive Service Manager to oversee a substantial service operation representing six leading automotive brands:  Audi, Volkswagen, Škoda, CUPRA, Geely and Zeekr.   You'll be joining a respected, family-owned dealership group, leading an experienced team and driving workshop performance, customer satisfaction and departmental profitability.   Benefits     Relocation assistance is available for the right candidate  Opportunity to lead a busy, multi-brand service department  Work with six leading automotive brands  Established, family-owned dealership group with over 34 years in the industry  Excellent lifestyle opportunity in Mount Maunganui     The Role     Lead, motivate and develop a team of Service Advisors and Automotive Technicians  Oversee daily service operations, workshop scheduling and workflow management  Drive departmental KPIs, technician productivity, efficiency and profitability  Monitor financial performance and identify opportunities for operational improvement  Maintain high standards of customer service and resolve escalated customer concerns  Ensure compliance with manufacturer requirements, warranty processes and health and safety standards     About You     Proven Service Management experience within an automotive service centre is essential  Experience managing multiple franchises or European automotive brands would be advantageous  Strong knowledge of workshop operations, technician productivity and departmental profitability  Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing team  Excellent communication, organisational and customer service skills  Commercially focused, proactive and confident managing a busy service operation  Experience with Autoline DMS would be beneficial but is not essential    If you are an experienced Automotive Service Manager looking for your next leadership opportunity with a well-established dealership group, we would like to hear from you.   Apply now with your CV and cover letter!

title: Service Manager
description: Job Description     Service Manager, Courts and Tribunals – Permanent/Fulltime position      Te Haeata/The Opportunity   We are looking for someone with experience leading a team and managing operations, providing guidance, training, and support, to ensure the team's efficient performance and professional development, whilst maintaining a positive team culture and environment.  This role is based at the Hutt Valley District Court with a  start date of 1 February 2027 . It reports to a Manager Justice Service and works collaboratively with a leadership team across two District Courts to strengthen people's trust in the Law of Aotearoa New Zealand.   Ō Pūkenga/Skills And Experience   No candidate will meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we have outlined and believe you can bring value to the role, we'd love to hear from you!  To be successful in this role, you will need the following skills, knowledge, and experience:    operational management experience, ideally in the District Court and Tribunals environment  previous experience in managing and developing the capability of staff  proven leadership skills to motivate and lead staff to achieve targets and understand their contribution to the bigger picture  good track record in supporting and implementing changes to business and work processes  be adaptable in a changing operations and customer centric environment  to possess well-developed interpersonal skills which will enable you to establish relationships and motivate others  able to develop and maintain strong working relationships  strong analytical, tactical, and strategic ability.     Mō Mātou/About Us   At Te Tāhū o te Ture - the Ministry of Justice, we're committed to strengthening people's trust in the law of Aotearoa, New Zealand.  Joining Te Tāhū o te Ture means you will become part of an organisation that welcomes and supports people of all gender identities, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, disabilities and religions.   Ngā painga o tēnei wāhi mahi/What's great about working here    Benefits   We offer you a range of benefits to support your wellbeing and help make the Ministry a great place to be. These include:    22 days holiday leave  an online professional development portal  access to a variety of inclusive and proactive networks    See our full range of benefits here.  With a wide range of jobs, you also get the chance to gain a variety of skills and experience while developing your career.   Utu ā-tau/Salary   The appointing salary for this role will be between $99,208 and $127,683 based on skills and experience.   Tono mai/Apply   You can view a detailed position description here, as well as complete an online application form by attaching your CV and cover letter.   Applications close on 6 November 2026 with interviews forecasted for 12 November 2026 for shortlisted candidates.   If you have any questions, please contact recruitment@justice.govt.nz and inc

title: Manager Servicios - Contact Center ATC con catalán
description: Desde nuestra consultora de selección, buscamos un/a Manager de Servicios de Contact Center ATC con catalán alto para una compañía de referencia. La persona seleccionada será responsable de gestionar los servicios, liderar equipos y garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de calidad, productividad y eficiencia.   Principales responsabilidades       Supervisar y coordinar la operativa de los servicios de Contact Center para recepción de llamadas con el fin de atender a los diferentes usuarios.  Liderar equipos y garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos operativos.  Realizar el seguimiento de KPIs y SLA, identificando desviaciones y proponiendo mejoras.  Gestionar la relación con clientes, elaborar informes y presentar resultados.  Impulsar la mejora continua de procesos y la optimización de recursos.  Supervisar costes y contribuir a la rentabilidad de los servicios.    Condiciones    Contrato Indefinido  Jornada completa en horario de 9:00 a 18:00h y viernes de 9:00 a 15:00h.  Ubicación: Barcelona  Paquete retributivo competitivo, acorde con la experiencia aportada.   Si cuentas con experiencia gestionando servicios de Contact Center, tienes un alto dominio del catalán y buscas un nuevo desafío profesional, ¡queremos conocerte!         REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:    Experiencia gestionando dos o más servicios de Contact Center de ATC o similar.  Nivel alto o nativo de catalán, imprescindible.  Experiencia liderando equipos y coordinando servicios.  Conocimiento de indicadores de calidad, productividad y niveles de servicio.  Capacidad analítica, orientación al cliente y habilidades de liderazgo y comunicación.  Manejo de herramientas CRM y reporting.   Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en la gestión de servicios de Contact Center externalizados para la Administración Pública.

title: Service Delivery Manager F/H
location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France
description: L'entreprise   EASYTEAM, étoile du groupe Constellation, est spécialisée dans les projets de Move to Cloud et les Services Managés.  Notre engagement : un accompagnement global 24/7 par des offres d’Audit, de Cadrage, de Déploiement et de Run.  Partenaire Oracle Platinum, IBM Platinum et Microsoft Gold , nous accompagnons nos clients sur toute la chaine de valeur au travers de nos offres de Conseil en stratégie Cloud, Migration, Services Managés, Automatisation & Observabilité, FinOps et Formation.  EASYTEAM, c’est plus de 200 collaborateurs répartis sur 12 agences : Saint-Cloud, Lille, Nantes, Rennes, Lyon avec une ambition de croissance forte.   Description Du Poste   Au sein de la Direction Relation Client, vous êtes l’interlocuteur d’un portefeuille de clients en infogérance. Vous en êtes responsable de bout en bout : la qualité du service, la santé financière des contrats et la relation dans la durée.   Au Quotidien, Vous     pilotez la production de vos clients avec le centre de service et les experts techniques, et vous garantissez le respect des SLA ;  gérez les incidents majeurs et menez l’amélioration continue de la prestation ;  prenez en charge les petits projets et suivez les plus complexes, confiés à un chef de projet, jusqu’au passage en RUN ;  suivez la facturation et le P&L de vos contrats, et vous expliquez au client les évolutions tarifaires ;  détectez les nouveaux besoins, faites les petits devis et pilotez les renouvellements avec les équipes commerciales ;  animez les COTECH et les COPIL, et vous mesurez la satisfaction de vos clients.     Profil recherché   Titulaire d’un Bac+5, vous avez 3 ans d’expérience dans les services d’infrastructure. Vous avez déjà été responsable d’une prestation devant un client, comme SDM, chef de projet infrastructure ou responsable de production.  Vous connaissez les environnements de production exigeants : virtualisation, haute disponibilité, fortes volumétries. ITIL est votre cadre de travail. Vous savez lire un contrat de services et suivre sa rentabilité : contrat, BPU, P&L.  Vous savez tenir une position face à un client tout en restant à son écoute. Vous savez aussi mobiliser des équipes techniques qui ne dépendent pas de vous hiérarchiquement.  Une certification en gestion de projet, une expérience de transformation Cloud et un anglais professionnel sont des plus.

title: Service Manager
description: ISS är ett ledande företag inom facility management och workplace experience. I över 80 år i Sverige och 125 år globalt har vi skapat platser och miljöer där människor trivs, utvecklas och presterar – och där företag och verksamheter kan fungera på bästa sätt.  Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning och teknisk service till mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. I Sverige är vi närmare 7 000 medarbetare och finns i hela landet, från norr till söder. Globalt är vi cirka 325 000 kollegor.  Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör. Med engagemang, omtanke och hög kvalitet skapar vi varje dag arbetsplatser som gör skillnad – för våra kunder, deras medarbetare och samhället omkring oss.   Jobbeskrivning    Gillar du människor, service och att få saker att hända? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!   Som Service Manager är du navet mellan kund, team och leverans. Du leder den dagliga verksamheten, skapar struktur och ser till att våra servicetjänster håller hög kvalitet, men framför allt arbetar du för att göra en bra leverans ännu bättre.  Du bygger starka relationer med kunden, fångar upp behov och hittar nya möjligheter att utveckla samarbetet. Samtidigt är du en närvarande ledare som skapar engagemang, arbetsglädje och utveckling i teamet.  Här får du en varierad roll där affärsmässighet möter människor och service, och där ingen dag behöver vara den andra lik. Du får möjlighet att påverka på riktigt och tillsammans med kund och kollegor skapa smarta lösningar, starka team och service i världsklass.   Kvalifikationer    Profil   Vi söker en engagerad ledare som skapar energi, bygger starka relationer och får teamet att växa. Du tycker om att skapa struktur och kvalitet, men är samtidigt nyfiken och ser möjligheter till förbättring och utveckling.  Du trivs nära både kund och verksamhet, där du får kombinera ledarskap, problemlösning och affärsmässighet. För dig handlar riktigt bra service inte bara om att leverera det som förväntas, utan om att hela tiden fundera på hur vi kan göra det lite bättre, lite smartare och skapa ännu mer värde tillsammans med kunden.  Kort sagt söker vi dig som gillar att bygga relationer, utveckla människor och driva verksamheten framåt.   Kvalifikationer     Erfarenhet av ledarskap med ansvar för personal, resultat och kundrelation   Erfarenhet från en serviceintensiv verksamhet, gärna inom Facility Management   God förståelse för ekonomi, uppföljning och kvalitet i leverans   Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska   God vana av digitala verktyg, exempelvis Microsoft Office     Erfarenhet från lokalvård eller andra servicetjänster är meriterande.   Ytterligare information    Vi erbjuder  en utvecklande roll där du arbetar nära kompetenta kollegor i en organisation som värdesätter samarbete, kvalitet och entreprenörskap. title: Service Delivery Manager (m/w/d)
description: Unser Auftraggeber ist ein etabliertes Technologieunternehmen, das anspruchsvolle technische Systeme und Komponenten für internationale Anwendungen entwickelt und realisiert. Das Unternehmen verbindet Entwicklung, Fertigung und technische Dienstleistungen und begleitet seine Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg.  Präzision, Qualität und zuverlässige Prozesse prägen das Arbeitsumfeld. Dich erwartet ein technisch anspruchsvolles Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit.   Rolle   Du suchst nach einer neuen Herausforderung als ICT Service Manager, in der du deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen einsetzen kannst. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Steuerung und den Betrieb von ICT-Services. Du verantwortest die Planung, Koordination und Überwachung von ICT-Projekten und -Prozessen. Mit deinem professionellen Erfahrungslevel bist du bestens gerüstet, um komplexe ICT-Herausforderungen zu meistern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du bist ein wichtiger Teil des ICT-Teams und trägst dazu bei, dass die ICT-Services reibungslos und effizient funktionieren.   Verantwortung     Du gestaltest eine leistungsfähige IT-Serviceorganisation und entwickelst Dienstleistungsangebote, Katalogstrukturen sowie Steuerungsprozesse weiter.  Du vereinbarst verbindliche Leistungsstandards mit internen und externen Partnern und stellst deren Einhaltung über den gesamten Servicelebenszyklus sicher.  Du analysierst Qualitätskennzahlen, erstellst Management-Dashboards und leitest gezielte Verbesserungsmassnahmen für den IT-Betrieb ab.  Du optimierst ServiceNow-Workflows, koordinierst Technologieanbieter und förderst transparente, effiziente Support- und Bereitstellungsprozesse.  Du entwickelst nachvollziehbare Kosten- und Verrechnungsmodelle, unterstützt strategische Sourcing-Entscheidungen und stärkst die serviceorientierte Zusammenarbeit.     Qualifikationen     Du verfügst über einen Abschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufspraxis im IT-Dienstleistungsmanagement.  Du kennst die ITIL-Prinzipien und bringst idealerweise eine anerkannte Zertifizierung im IT-Service-Management mit.  Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung von IT-Services, Dienstleistungspartnern oder komplexen Betriebsvereinbarungen.  Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Netzwerken, Serverplattformen, Cloud-Diensten und digitalen Arbeitsplatzlösungen.  Du überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. title: Service Manager 80-100%
description: Die SPIE Schweiz AG ist ein Schweizer Full-Service Anbieter für ICT-, Multitechnik- E-Mobility und Facility-Services. Mit den Divisionen SPIE ICS (Information Communication Services), SPIE MTS (Multi-Technical Services) und SPIE IFS (Integral Facility Services) werden schweizweit an 8 Standorten Dienstleistungen in den Sektoren Smart City, Energie, effiziente Gebäude und Industrie angeboten.  Als  Service Manager  bist Du verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung eines stabilen, effizienten und kundenorientierten Servicebetriebs. Du steuerst und überwachst die vereinbarten Serviceleistungen anhand definierter SLA- und KPI-Vorgaben und stellst deren Einhaltung sicher. Dabei koordinierst Du die relevanten ITIL-Prozesse wie Incident-, Problem-, Change- und Release-Management und arbeitest eng mit Kunden, internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern zusammen.     Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören die Analyse und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Service- und Betriebsprozessen, die Identifikation von Verbesserungspotenzialen sowie die Umsetzung geeigneter Massnahmen zur Steigerung von Servicequalität, Kundenzufriedenheit und Betriebseffizienz. Du erstellst aussagekräftige Service-Reports, führst regelmässige Service Reviews durch und sorgst für Transparenz hinsichtlich Serviceleistung, Risiken und Handlungsbedarf.    Darüber hinaus übernimmst Du die fachliche Steuerung von Lieferanten und Partnern, koordinierst Eskalationen und stellst die nachhaltige Behebung von Störungen und Serviceproblemen sicher. Du unterstützt die Planung und Überwachung von Servicebudgets und Ressourcen und wirkst aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung des Serviceportfolios mit.    Mit Deiner ausgeprägten Serviceorientierung, Deinem analytischen Denkvermögen und Deiner Kommunikationsstärke trägst Du wesentlich zur Sicherstellung einer hohen Servicequalität und zu einer nachhaltigen, vertrauensvollen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Partnern und internen Stakeholdern bei.       Dein Profil:    Mehrjährige Erfahrung im ICT-Service Management  Fundierte Kenntnisse in ITIL und ITSM-Prozessen  Erfahrung in Incident-, Problem-, Change- und Release-Management  Routine in der Steuerung von SLA, KPI und Servicequalität  Erfahrung mit ITSM-Tools und Service-Reporting  Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise  Ausgeprägte Kunden-, Service- und Stakeholderorientierung  Erfahrung in Lieferanten-, Budget- und Ressourcenmanagement  Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift  Arbeitsort: Bern    Bist du an der Stelle interessiert? title: Medical Centre Manager - Tend Beckford and Waltham
description: Opportunity to lead!!!   At Tend we’re reimagining healthcare for New Zealanders, putting patients at the heart of what we do, creating choice, control and a quality of service that’s unmatched in Aotearoa.  The Medical Centre Manager is pivotal to delivering the exceptional Customer Experience Tend prides itself on, and executing on our vision of making New Zealanders the healthiest people in the world, by leading a group of clinics that make up our national network of primary care services. You will partner with our central clinical team (CCT), customer experience team (CET) and our central functions to manage the general operations of clinics.  With the acquisition of The Doctors we now have over 90 clinics across the Motu so you will have plenty of support with our central Technology, Clinical Support, Operations, People & Finance team to help you thrive at our two clinics!  You will work across two clinics, Tend Beckford and Tend Waltham. The distance is just over 1km between the clinics. You will be able to set your clinic scheduling as part of your role.   Our ideal person for this role will have:     Experience managing primary or secondary care services, ideally in general practice  Service management & managing a multidisciplinary team  Strong facilitation & negotiation/persuasion skills  Strong working knowledge of Practice Management Systems, preferably Indici and ability to pick up technology systems with ease     This role will be responsible for:     Clinic operations  Leadership of the teams  Strategy & delivery  Financial performance, people & risk management.    The successful candidate will have support from our People, Finance, Operations, Customer Experience and Leadership team, to implement change & integration at the clinics. title: ELP & Repairs Demand Management Manager
description: The Post holder will report to the Qatar Head of Supply Chain for the Supply Services Operations Service and will be responsible for meeting agreed KPIs and availability output on a daily basis for all ML2 ML4 assets on base through the Depth Bays to meet operational requirements. This will involve supplier negotiations and engineering change.  Maintain Supply Chain Data quality, manage the movement and quality assurance of all assets within Maintenix through the ELP including Part M inspection and the expedient resolution of all quarantined items.  The Upgrade & Modifications Management service - will co-ordinate and control all Customer upgrade assets through the Supply Services in line with agreed modification plans and individual Customer constraints.  The post holder will be responsible for building and maintaining excellent working relationships with both the on base depth bays, ML4 order book service Manager, IMS Business Support manager and CAMO Data Integrity Manager in addition to the Customer organisation for the optimisation of repairable assets on base.  Furthermore, they will be responsible for ensuring that the allocated resource has appropriate skills, is motivated, effective and at all times complies with Safety, Quality and other internal and external regulations. Resolve and escalate issues as appropriate   Completion of activities – Ensure all repairs management activities and transactions are appropriately documented and records maintained on relevant systems (IT / paper based). Responsible for the continuous development of activities including facilitation and management of reviews.   Optimisation of on base repairs through the Depth Bays and efficient management of ML4 assets to meet the operational requirement of the contract to support operational flying requirements and the capability of the bay, planning and forecasting bay throughput to maintain serviceable assets in stock.   Safety Management System – Thorough knowledge of human factors, error management, risk and safety management, within a CAO environment, together with undertaking proactive hazard analysis and mitigation. title: IT Service Manager

Pour cela, Bump fournit des  solutions de recharge 360°  aux entreprises pour les aider à électrifier leurs flottes de véhicules.      2 marchés  :   Les professionnels et les entreprises équipés de flottes  Les foncières tertiaires et commerciales       Descriptif du poste :      L’équipe Customer Delivery (anciennement Commissioning) est le garant de la promesse faite à nos clients : des bornes qui fonctionnent, et une qualité de service qui tient dans la durée. Suite à l’évolution de notre organisation,  nous faisons le choix stratégique d’intégrer pleinement la relation et le pilotage client de bout en bout au sein du pôle  : l’Operation Manager qui orchestre la reprise d’un parc reste le point de contact privilégié du client dans la durée. Le Team Lead Operations - Entreprise doit apporter de la structure, sécuriser l’amont commercial et transformer les process de reprise (RES) encore artisanaux en standards industriels reproductibles.      Ton rôle :      En tant que Team Lead, tu es le garant du delivery et la relation client sur le segment des Grands Comptes. Tu es responsable de garantir une exécution robuste, fiable et lisible (en interne comme vis-à-vis des clients) tout en portant une dynamique d’équipe exigeante sur des portefeuilles complexes. Tu es à la fois le pivot de la relation client stratégique, le garant des marges en phase d’avant-vente et le leader pour structurer ton équipe. Définir la répartition des comptes et piloter la charge de l’équipe pour tenir les engagements de delivery. Jusqu'en 2023, chez Lucca, ce sont nos consultants qui répondaient aux tickets, en plus de déployer et paramétrer nos solutions. description: Vill du växa våra kundrelationer med försäljning och AI?       Föräldravikariat · heltid · 12 månader från januari 2027      På Draftit hjälper vi organisationer att omsätta krav på dataskydd och informationssäkerhet i praktiken. Nu flyttar vi vårt kundarbete från reaktivt till proaktivt. AI-agenter, bland annat vår egen Lex, svarar redan på kundernas mejl och telefonsamtal, så att vi får tid att förutse behov och växa relationerna i stället för att bara lösa ärenden.     Vi söker dig som vill sälja mer till kunder som redan litar på oss. Du använder redan AI-agenter i ditt arbete och vågar ta första kontakten och driva saker framåt själv. Dataskydd och informationssäkerhet lär vi dig.      Ditt uppdrag      Tjänsten är uppdelad ungefär 50/50.       1. Växa våra befintliga kunder (främsta fokus: merförsäljning)    Hitta och driva merförsäljning och leads inom dataskydd och informationssäkerhet hos befintliga kunder. Du leder med frågor, förstår kundens verklighet och tar det vidare med Sales.  Använda kundhälsodata och AI-agenter för att se både möjligheter och varningstecken i tid.  Vara kundens röst internt mot Product och Development.       2. Ansvara för våra HR-kunder    Vara kontaktperson för kunder med serviceavtal: förvaltningsmöten, administratörsutbildningar och kvalitetssäkring av portaler.  Ansvara för kollektivavtal, Kollektivavtalsbanken och Adminguiden.  Möta HR-kunderna med dataskydd och informationssäkerhet som nästa steg.  Supportera kunder via mail och telefon samt på begäran göra uppdateringar i kundernas system.       Du får tydliga rutiner och stöd av teamet, så du behöver inte komma med HR-kunskap.     Vi mäter inte framgång i antal kundsamtal. Vi mäter den i genomförda merförsäljningar och leads som Sales tar vidare.      Vem är du?      Vi tror att du har en kombination av försäljningsdrivkraft, nyfikenhet och mod.      Du säljer . Du har drivit merförsäljning eller affärer och kan visa resultat. Du är intresserad av vad som får kunder att agera och hur du hittar ett behov som kunden själv inte sett.      Du använder AI . Du använder redan AI-agenter i ditt arbete och kan visa hur de hjälper dig att arbeta smartare. Vi vill att du tillför kunskap till oss, inte att vi lär upp dig från grunden.      Du tar ägarskap . Du väntar inte på att kunden hör av sig. Du tar initiativ, ringer, prioriterar och driver arbetet framåt.   Du lär dig snabbt.  Du sätter dig in i nya regelverk och produkter och förklarar dem enkelt för kunden. Eftersom ett vikariat inte lämnar utrymme för lång upplärning förväntar vi oss att du är i gång inom några veckor.      Du utvecklar kundrelationer . Du kommunicerar väl i tal och skrift och agerar snabbt på frågor från kunderna. Du sätter dig in i kundens perspektiv för att säkerställa att kunden uppnår maximal nytta av våra tjänster och produkter.       Vi ser gärna att du har:    Erfarenhet av merförsäljning eller upsell till befintliga kunder  Erfarenhet av kundsupport, projektledning och admin

title: Partner Marketing Manager

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. TRM Labs is building the global standard for investigations.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Engineering - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

At Ashby,

title: Product Support Specialist - Americas
description:
Hello! We're Jason and Charlie, Support Managers at Ashby. We’re excited to share that we're hiring Product Support Specialists in North America.

Over the past few years, we’ve built a team of Ashby experts who delight customers through keen attention to detail, deep product knowledge, and fast, thoughtful support. By joining the team, you’ll contribute to delivering that same world-class experience.

In this role, you’ll work closely with customers every day. Ashby is a broad and complex product, so you can expect to handle everything from troubleshooting sophisticated integrations to guiding customers through detailed workflows and best practices.

You’ll also spend time on projects that make the work we do better. Past projects our team has taken on include:

  • Absorbing and synthesizing highly technical work from our Engineering Team to create enablement for technical up-leveling of the broader Support Team.

  • Developing workflow automation allowing for better team cohesion and efficacy.

As a company, we value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication. These and other values, which we’ll explore more deeply during the interview process, guide how we work.

You should apply if:

  • You are already comfortable owning complex SaaS troubleshooting from first report through resolution, including isolating configuration issues, reproducing ambiguous behavior, and communicating clearly

  • You can explain technical issues concisely, you think systematically, and operate with strong ownership in asynchronous environments. You can explain the same issue differently depending on the audience, while staying clear and direct.

  • You’re curious—both when addressing customers and when creating solutions that improve our workflows. You seek the answers beyond what’s on the surface.

  • You delight customers. You possess keen attention to detail, ensure your responses are thorough and clear, and are empathetic along the way.

  • You can balance investigation, customer communication, and escalation quality in a fast-moving environment.

  • You've done B2B support across company sizes, from SMB to enterprise.

You should not apply if:

  • Your recent experience is primarily customer success management, account management, or customer onboarding

  • You're more drawn to coordination, enablement, or team leadership than spending your days deep in tickets.

  • You avoid getting in the weeds of solving technical problems; each member of our support team is highly technical and capable of solving deeply complex tickets.

As a company, we value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication. These and other values, which we’ll explore more deeply during the interview process, guide how we work.

You should apply if:

  • You are already comfortable owning complex SaaS troubleshooting from first report through resolution, including isolating configuration issues, reproducing ambiguous behavior, and communicating clearly

  • You can explain technical issues concisely, you think systematically, and operate with strong ownership in asynchronous environments. You can explain the same issue differently depending on the audience, while staying clear and direct.

  • You’re curious—both when addressing customers and when creating solutions that improve our workflows. You seek the answers beyond what’s on the surface.

  • You delight customers. You possess keen attention to detail, ensure your responses are thorough and clear, and are empathetic along the way.

  • You can balance investigation, customer communication, and escalation quality in a fast-moving environment.

  • You've done B2B support across company sizes, from SMB to enterprise.

You should not apply if:

  • Your recent experience is primarily customer success management, account management, or customer onboarding

  • You're more drawn to coordination, enablement, or team leadership than spending your days deep in tickets.

  • You avoid getting in the weeds of solving technical problems; each member of our support team is highly technical and capable of solving deeply complex tickets.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Product Engineering - EU
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. title: Site Reliability Engineer (Network)
description:
Wanna join the adventure?
 

As a Site Reliability Engineer with strong networking skills in our Cloud Infrastructure (SRE) team, you help the team own the networks that keep Loft running: cloud networking, VPN and site-to-site connectivity, segmentation, and routing across our offices, test equipment, and ground stations. You keep them reliable, observable, and secure as we scale. You coordinate with IT on the network components that interface with the physical infrastructure used by employees. You’ll work the way an SRE team works: defining reliability in measurable terms (SLOs for connectivity and ground-station availability), instrumenting the systems that prove it, managing the network as code, and automating away toil so on-call load doesn’t grow with the fleet.
