title: Product Manager
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Deployment & Runtime Environments
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. We own how software gets packaged, deployed, and executed onboard: from the tool that assembles and maintains mission-specific software stacks, to the Runtime Container Environment that lets partner and customer workloads run securely in orbit, to the Linux infrastructure that makes it all reliable. As more satellite programs come online and as we open our container runtime to a growing number of external workloads, the team’s scope is expanding fast.

We’re looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who digs into an unfamiliar system, maps it out, and gets it shipped without needing the path handed to them. You’ll move between Linux internals, container runtimes, and CI pipelines, sometimes in the same afternoon.


About this role:
  • Contribute to and evolve our bundle management tool — the tool that resolves package dependencies, assembles mission-specific software stacks, and enables the Solutions team to spin up and maintain an ever-growing number of satellite programs
  • Develop and harden our onboard Linux infrastructure: how services are deployed on the rootfs, what system manages their execution, and how we ensure reliable and recoverable Linux operation in orbit
  • Evolve our Runtime Container Environment — the container manager and the full stack around it (base images, container registry service) — enabling partner and customer work

title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Marketplace
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end-to-end and ship weekly.

About this role:
  • Build the Marketplace storefront, partner portal, and admin tooling.
  • Design and implement the APIs and services behind them: catalog, onboarding, entitlements, and metering.
  • Integrate with our mission platform for authentication, workflow triggers, and solution deployment in close collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Build connectors for third-party constellations and data providers.
  • Own quality: tests, CI/CD, monitoring.

Must Haves:
  • 4+ years building and shipping full-stack products.
  • Experience with Sprint development.
  • Strong TypeScript/React or Vue on the front end and solid backend experience in either Python, Go, or Node.
  • Cloud-native by default (we run on GCP): containers/kubernetes, managed services, infrastructure as code.
  • Comfortable with API design, OAuth, and multi-tenant authorization.
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development workflows and expected to use them.
  • You have shipped a zero-to-one product, ideally a marketplace, developer platform, or SaaS portal, and you like small teams with large scope.

Als Mitglied der internationalen PureGym Gruppe mit mehr als 2 Millionen Mitgliedern gehören wir zu den drei größten Fitnessketten in Europa und sind damit bestens aufgestellt, um unsere ehrgeizigen Ziele weiter zu verfolgen und zu realisieren. So können wir in Zukunft einen noch grösseren und wichtigeren Beitrag zur Fitness und Gesundheit der Schweizer Bevölkerung leisten.


Für unser motiviertes Group Fitness Team in Lenzburg  suchen wir ab sofort eine leidenschaftliche und sportbegeisterte Person als Group Fitness Instructor (m/w/d) unter anderem für die folgenden Kurse zu folgenden Zeiten:

BODYPUMP und ZUMBA.

Du möchtest lieber flexibel als Selbstständige/r arbeiten? Kein Problem – alternativ zur Festanstellung bieten wir dir auch eine freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit zu einem attraktiven höheren Stundenlohn an. Sprich uns gerne direkt darauf an. Für weitere Informationen hierzu wenden dich bitte direkt an die Studioleitung.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du leitest die Group Fitness Kurse und vermittelst dein Fachwissen mit grosser Begeisterung

  • Du bist für unsere Mitglieder da und betreust sie vor, während und nach deinen Kursen

  • Du bereitest deine Kurse vor, hältst die Gruppendynamik aufrecht und motivierst deine Teilnehmer:innen während des Kurses

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Sauberkeit und Hygieneregeln im Kursraum

  • Du kennst unsere Angebote und unsere Philosophie und kannst diese den Mitgliedern vermitteln

  • Du sorgst idealerweise selbstständig für deine Stellvertretungen und bist auch bereit bei Bedarf selbst als Stellvertretung einzuspringen


Was du mitbringst:

  • Du hast bereits fundierte Erfahrung als Groupfitness

description:
Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. title: Reliability Engineer

Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group

About the role.

We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.



How you embrace curiosity daily.

  • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

  • Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

  • Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

  • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

title: Chief Information Security Officer

Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

title: Afstudeerstage Marketing
description:
Afstudeeropdracht: Ontwerp een innovatief product voor de groei van 12Build!

Over 12Build

12Build is een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en zo de samenwerking in de bouw makkelijker en transparanter maakt. We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We hebben meer dan 90 collega’s op kantoren in Nijverdal en Zwolle. Ons platform wordt dagelijks gebruikt in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken, en we willen heel Europa veroveren. Met zo’n snelle groei liggen er veel vragen klaar waar nog niemand goed antwoord op heeft. Daar zoeken we jou voor.

De opdracht

We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Je gaat samen met Ed, je begeleider vanuit 12Build, uitzoeken welke uitdaging het beste past bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert.

Ontwerpvraag (startpunt):

Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen:

• AI en kennisdeling: hoe zetten we AI in om klanten en gebruikers te helpen, bijvoorbeeld met cursussen of leercontent in de 12Build Academy?.

• Groei en leadgeneratie: hoe trekken we meer nieuwe klanten aan en volgen we leads slimmer op, bijvoorbeeld met lead scoring of automatisering?.

• Self-service: hoe zorgen we dat gebruikers zelf de weg vinden op het platform en sneller een betalend account nemen?.

• Internationale groei: hoe pakken we een nieuwe markt aan en wat werkt in Nederland wel of juist niet in Duitsland of Denemarken?.

title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager med bakgrunn fra næringseiendom søkes. Bli med i et spennende vekstselskap under Visma-paraplyen som jobber med å digitalisere eiendomsbransjen!       Fenistra – Vi kan eiendom!       Eiendomsbransjen er viktig for å levere og forvalte solide og bærekraftige bygg som vi kan bo, jobbe og leve i. Dette er en bransje som står overfor store endringer som blant annet høyere kostnader, regulatoriske endringer og ikke minst det grønne skiftet. Samtidig er ny og spennende teknologi høyt etterspurt og på vei inn i bransjen.       Digitalisering vil være avgjørende for å lykkes med de nødvendige endringene eiendomsbransjen står overfor. Vi satser derfor tungt på å utvikle og tiltrekke seg software til eiendomsbransjen.     Du vil jobbe i Visma Property Solutions med vårt kjerneprodukt, Fenistra. Våre kunder er primært eiendomsbesittere og utviklere av næringseiendom og økosystemet rundt dem, som forvaltere, meglere og finansinstitusjoner.        Fenistra er Norges største forvaltningsplattform av eiendom og bidrar til en effektiv økonomisk og kommersiell forvaltning. Produktet har de siste årene gjennomgått en stor fornyelse og med ny teknologi ser vi nye muligheter som også påvirker produktet videre, kundereisen og vårt arbeid med kundeforvaltning - her vil du få en sentral rolle.      Om stillingen   Vi har siste tiden bygget opp Customer Success-funksjonen vår med gode rammeverk, metoder og rutiner. Nå søker vi en ny kollega til teamet, denne gangen med bakgrunn fra næringseiendomsbransjen. Din innsikt i hvordan eiendomsselskaper jobber og hvilke behov og utfordringer de har i hverdagen, vil gjøre deg i stand til å komme raskt i gang med kundene våre. Du vil også få en sentral stemme inn mot produktteamet i det videre arbeidet med utviklingen av Fenistra.       Samtidig er dette fortsatt en fullverdig CSM-rolle. Du skal drive proaktiv kundeoppfølging, sikre god onboarding og opplæring, og være kundenes viktigste kontaktpunkt for å få mest mulig verdi ut av løsningen. Vi ser derfor etter deg som kombinerer bransjeforståelse med gode relasjonelle egenskaper og evnen til å jobbe strukturert og proaktivt med kunder i hverdagen.       Stillingen går under avdeling Customers & Growth, som består av 12 engasjerte kollegaer i kommersielle og operasjonelle roller. Du blir del av et CSM-team sammen med 3 kolleger og vil ha reell mulighet til å videre påvirke både Customer Success-arbeidet og produktet vårt.      Hva vil du gjøre?   •  Bringe bransjeinnsikt inn i selskapet og bidra til at Fenistra løser reelle behov i eiendomsforvaltningen    •  Proaktiv kundeoppfølging drevet av data, segmentering og analyse av kundenes behov og bruksmønstre    •  Innledende rådgivning innenfor fagområdene vi leverer tjenester for    •  Onboarding og opplæring av kunder i produktet    •  Bistå kunden i å få mest mulig verdi ut av våre løsninger    •  Videreutvikle vår Customer Success-strategi, kundereise og interne rutiner for oppfølging og støtt

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: Do you want to make sure some of Europe's largest employers get real value from their pay transparency work, and grow long partnerships from it? Help them turn pay transparency from a deadline into a lasting capability.    About Sysarb   Sysarb has worked on pay equity since 2005, when we set out to challenge unfair salary practices in Sweden. Today hundreds of organisations, from Swedish municipalities to global enterprises, use our platform to design compensation structures, run pay equity analysis, communicate pay to managers and employees, and report under pay transparency regulation.  The EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU 2023/970) had a transposition deadline of 7 June 2026. Member states are at very different stages, and for employers with people in several countries, that fragmentation is the actual problem. It is why demand for what we do keeps growing.  We are a Swedish company with a European market focus, operating across 70+ countries, and a founding member of the Pay Transparency Alliance.   What This Role Is About   As Enterprise Customer Success Manager you own the customer value of a portfolio of 40+ enterprise customers after go-live. You make Sysarb an operational part of how each customer sets, analyses and communicates pay. When customers get that value, it shows up as adoption, renewals and growth, and you own that result too.  Our Sales team lands new customers. You make them successful and grow them. Once a customer is live, you own the relationship, the value plan, the renewal and the expansion, and Sales joins you on larger or multi-year deals.  The role has three parts:    Customer value partner (most important). You know what success looks like for each customer and drive adoption to get there. You track usage and health, act early on risk, and own the feedback loop with Product.  Commercial owner. You turn that value into renewals and expansion. You run those deals yourself and bring in Sales on larger ones.  Product savvy. You understand SaaS and how our platform works, including data flows and integrations. You demo it, answer most questions yourself and know when to bring in our technical experts.    Value comes first, and the commercial results follow from it. You are commercially strong, but your work starts with the customer, not the deal. The product part is about being street smart, not being an engineer.   Three things that make this role different     You make value visible. Employers are moving from first compliance to running pay transparency every year. You agree with each customer what success looks like, track it, and show it in every business review.  You own the whole loop. You bring structured customer feedback to Product, framed as customer value, and you close the loop with the customer. You know the roadmap well enough to explain what is coming and why.  You own a portfolio, with a team behind you. Sales lands new customers so you can focus on making existing ones succeed. 40+ enterprise accoun

description: Osaatko tehdä asiakastuen arjesta sujuvaa, auttaa ihmisiä onnistumaan ja viedä kehitysideoita käytäntöön? Etsimme Kiholle asiakastuen ratkaisukeskeistä esihenkilöä, joka tarttuu myös itse asiakkaiden kysymyksiin.      Kiho on suomalainen teknologiayritys, joka digitalisoi liikkuvaa työtä tekevien yritysten kalustonhallintaa, työn ohjausta ja laskutusta. Meille tärkeintä on olla tekijöiden puolella ja rakentaa teknologian avulla maailmaa, jossa tekeminen on mahdollista myös tulevaisuudessa. Organisoit ja priorisoit työtä, suunnittelet resursointia ja huolehdit työn sujuvuudesta myös ruuhka-aikoina ja poissaolojen aikana.  Tuet tiimiä ja kehität osaamista. Asetat selkeät tavoitteet, annat palautetta, huolehdit perehdytyksestä ja autat jokaista onnistumaan työssään.  Kehität prosesseja ja työkaluja. Viet käytäntöön parannuksia asiakastuen työnkulkuihin, dokumentaatioon ja tiedonhallintaan sekä vastaat asiakastuen osuudesta HubSpot-prosesseissa.  Varmistat laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen. Osallistut tukipyyntöjen ratkaisemiseen, autat vaativissa asiakastilanteissa ja huolehdit asiakkaiden sujuvasta siirtymisestä käyttöönotosta asiakastuen piiriin.  Koordinoit laite- ja kumppaniyhteistyötä. Huolehdit paikanninlaitteiden varastokirjanpidosta ja tilauksista sovittujen käytäntöjen mukaisesti sekä yhteistyöstä asennuskumppanien ja liittymätoimittajien kanssa. Onnistumisesi näkyy sujuvampana arkena, laadukkaina ratkaisuina ja kehittyvänä tiiminä. Rakennat asiakastuen laatua ja tehokkuutta kuvaavan seurannan yhdessä oman esihenkilösi kanssa. You will lead a dedicated local team, drive cross-functional collaboration, and ensure seamless service delivery during an important period of organizational evolution. Balancing operational stability with continuous improvement, you will build a high-performing, customer-focused team culture, and directly influence how the organization serves its customers today and tomorrow. You have a strong track record of people management or are ready to step into team leadership responsibility, with the ability to coach, motivate, and hold others accountable.  You communicate with clarity and confidence, and you are skilled at managing stakeholders across functions such as sales, supply chain, quality, and finance.  You are comfortable navigating change and continuous improvement at the same time, with sound judgment and a strong sense of ownership.  You are experienced in working across functions in complex business environments, with the ability to prioritize, solve problems, and drive actions with urgency and clarity. title: International Relationship Manager
description: Job Description    Managing a portfolio of international corporate clients is demanding work - and it matters. In Global Subsidiaries Finland, you will work at the center of cross-border business relationships, connecting clients with the right colleagues and solutions at the right time. This role offers real responsibility, close access to senior bankers, and genuine room to grow.    What You Will Be Doing   You will join an experienced and supportive team based in Helsinki, focused on serving international Business Customer and Large Corporate and Institutional clients across Finland. The team works in a collaborative and straightforward manner, drawing on specialists in financing, Cash Management, Trade Finance, and FX to deliver for clients. You will manage your own client portfolio with a good degree of autonomy, while staying well connected to senior bankers and product specialists across the bank.  More specifically, you will:    Manage and grow a portfolio of international BC and LC&I clients  Anticipate client needs, spot business opportunities, and address risks early  Collaborate with senior bankers and specialists across financing, Cash Management, Trade Finance, and FX  Guide client matters from the initial discussion through to execution and follow-up  Acquire new clients and contribute to the growth of the business     About You     At least few years of experience in corporate banking, finance, or a relevant advisory role  Strong integrity and sound judgement, particularly when decisions are not straightforward  Good understanding of credit and a genuine interest in international business  A proactive work approach and ability to keep multiple client matters moving forward  Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work  Fluent in Finnish and English; knowledge of another Nordic language is an advantage     What We Offer You   You will become part of an experienced and supportive team based at our Finnish headquarters in Pasila, Helsinki, where collaboration and being open are the norm. The role follows a hybrid working model, with three to four days per week in the office. You will have direct access to senior colleagues, real responsibility from the start, and the space to build your skills and career within an international banking environment.   Are you ready for the next step?   If this sounds like the right move for you, please send your CV and cover letter via our recruitment system by  November 11th, 2026 . For questions about the role, please contact the hiring manager Aleksi Soininen at aleksi.soininen@danskebank.com or +358 (0)44 241 8401, on Monday 2nd Nov at 12-14, Wednesday 4th at 12-14, or Friday 6th at 12-14.  We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Director of Private Wealth
description: Lesha Bank is searching for the greatest talent and brightest minds to contribute to the current growth phase at our bank. We are looking for top-tier individuals who are passionate and hungry to add value from day one. Every day at Lesha is different, presenting a new challenge with the opportunity to contribute and grow. We are looking for a Director of Private Wealth.      Role purpose   Drive capital raising and investment distribution for Lesha Bank’s offerings across private capital, aviation, infrastructure, real estate and public equities. Acquire and develop relationships with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices and other eligible investors, converting these relationships into funded investments and repeat participation in the Bank’s offerings.      Key responsibilities    Capital raising and business development    Raise capital and attract client allocations into Lesha Bank’s investment offerings, delivering agreed fundraising, net new money and revenue targets.  Develop and execute distribution plans for investment opportunities across private capital, aviation, infrastructure, real estate and public equities.  Originate new investor relationships in Qatar and approved regional markets through professional networks, referrals and targeted outreach.  Increase investment participation from existing clients by identifying suitable opportunities aligned with their objectives.  Manage the fundraising pipeline from prospect identification through investor engagement, commitment, subscription and funding.  Maintain accurate forecasts and report on fundraising progress, expected inflows and conversion rates.       Investor relationship management    Manage an assigned portfolio of investors, understanding their investment objectives, risk appetite, liquidity needs and allocation preferences.  Build long-term relationships with investors, family offices and their advisers through regular meetings and proactive communication.  Present investment opportunities clearly, explaining the investment rationale, structure, fees, potential returns, material risks and liquidity or exit considerations.  Coordinate investor presentations and due diligence discussions with the Bank’s investment specialists.  Maintain engagement after investment, coordinating timely updates on performance, distributions and material developments.       Investment knowledge and collaboration    Develop a thorough understanding of the Bank’s offerings across the five investment areas and their respective risk and return characteristics.  Work with investment teams to communicate investment propositions accurately and respond to investor enquiries.  Provide feedback on investor demand, allocation preferences and reasons for declining opportunities to inform product development and distribution strategy.  Coordinate with Operations, Legal, Compliance and other relevant teams to ensure timely onboarding, documentation, subscriptions and funding.

title: Kundcenterchef
description: Vi vill vara branschens mest omtyckta arbetsgivare. Inte störst – men bäst när det gäller. Därför investerar vi i våra medarbetare och satsar hållbart för framtiden. Hos oss får du korta beslutsvägar och ett team som samarbetar för att ge bygg- och entreprenadföretag rätt maskin på rätt plats – varje dag.    Nu söker vi en    Kundcenterchef till Umeå    som vill leda och utveckla verksamheten med både affärsfokus och starkt ledarskap.    Ditt uppdrag som Kundcenterchef   Som kundcenterchef hos Arento i Umeå har du ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten – med fokus på lönsamhet, tillväxt och kundnöjdhet. Du leder det dagliga arbetet i kundcentret och säkerställer struktur, effektivitet och hög servicenivå.  Du driver verksamheten både operativt och strategiskt, och arbetar nära både kunder och medarbetare för att skapa bästa möjliga resultat.  En viktig del av rollen är att utveckla affären på den lokala marknaden genom att bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter.    Driva daglig styrning genom morgonmöten samt följa upp verksamheten via månatliga APT  Säkerställa hög servicenivå och att kundens behov alltid står i fokus  Arbeta aktivt med budget, resultat och uppföljning av relevanta nyckeltal  Bevaka och bearbeta den lokala marknaden genom kundbesök  Leda, utveckla och inspirera teamet för att nå gemensamma mål  Driva kundcentrets tillväxt och bredda kundbasen     Vem är du?    Vi söker dig som är en trygg och engagerad ledare med stark affärsförståelse. Du drivs av att utveckla både människor och verksamhet, och har förmågan att skapa struktur samtidigt som du är flexibel och lösningsorienterad.  Du har lätt för att bygga relationer och trivs i en roll där du kombinerar ledarskap med kundkontakt.  Vi ser att du har:    Erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team  God affärsförståelse samt erfarenhet av budget- och resultatansvar  Erfarenhet av B2B-affärer och kundbearbetning  Förmåga att skapa och upprätthålla långsiktiga kundrelationer  Intresse för och gärna kunskap om maskiner, fordon eller utrustning inom anläggning  God datorvana (Office-paketet)  Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift  B-körkort     Vi erbjuder dig   Hos oss blir du snabbt en i gänget. Inom Arento delar vi med oss av kunskap och drar nytta av varandras styrkor. Det ger dig unika utvecklingsmöjligheter och öppnar för spännande utmaningar i ett företag i snabb förändring. Med tydliga prestationsmål och utmanande arbetsuppgifter får du utrymme att vässa din spetskompetens och göra skillnad. Och det är lika lätt att få ansvar som att ge – oavsett om du vill göra en ledarskapsresa eller bli specialist. Karriärvägarna är många. Vi uppskattar när du är innovativ. Tillsammans tar vi nästa steg genom att lyssna på kunderna och utveckla hållbara lösningar. Det finns med andra ord många fördelar att dela väg med oss.   Ansök idag!   Vill du ta nästa steg i din karriär och leda vårt kundcenter i Umeå? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan!  Vi arbetar me

title: IAM Success Manager
description: Are you ready to shape the future of Identity & Access Management?  Identity & Access Management (IAM) is becoming increasingly important as organizations evolve, digitalize, and strengthen their security posture. At If, we are developing modern IAM capabilities that support our employees, partners, and customers while enabling secure and efficient business operations.  We are looking for an IAM Success Manager to join our IAM organization and help drive adoption, engagement, and continuous improvement across our IAM services and products.  This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of people, processes, technology, and communication. You do not need to be a deep IAM expert from day one, more important is your ability to collaborate with different stakeholders, understand user needs, drive improvements, and help others succeed.   About The Role   As an IAM Success Manager, you will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, product managers, architects, and end users across the organization.  The role combines elements of product management, service management, stakeholder engagement, communication, and change enablement. You will contribute to ensuring that IAM services deliver value, are understood by their users, and continue to evolve based on business needs and feedback.  You will help connect business and technology perspectives, support adoption of IAM capabilities, contribute to communication and awareness activities, and participate in shaping the future direction of identity-related services for human and non-human identities.   We Offer     Benefits   In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:    An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome   Career and development opportunities in the largest insurance company in the Nordics   Social activities and a highly skilled professional environment   Possibility of hybrid workplace   Health-promoting workplace with wellness allowance and sports activities   Great insurance benefits      About The Team   You’ll join Digital Sales and Customer Experience, within Business Area Private, focusing on digital enablers for transformation. Our team lives by If’s core values - collaborating across business and IT to deliver the IAM services our business needs. We believe in creativity, courage, and smart investments to meet future customer demands.   Who Are You?    You are curious, collaborative, and motivated by helping people and organizations succeed. You are comfortable working across different teams and can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.  What we hope you bring    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills   A customer and user-oriented mindset   Ability to coordinate activities across multiple teams   Experience in security, digit

title: IT Support Lead (Service Delivery)
description: Du willst ein Supportteam führen, das Kunden verlässlich und planbar betreut? Du sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen in der richtigen Priorität bei der richtigen Person landet, dass Termine halten und Kunden wissen, woran sie sind? Dann passt diese Rolle zu dir.  Für einen lokalen IT Service Provider in der Region Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als  IT Support Lead (Service Delivery) .  Unser Kunde verbindet IT Solutions, Webentwicklung und Digital Signage. Er betreut regional verankerte KMU, Gemeinden und Schulen: von Microsoft 365, Security, Netzwerk und VoIP bis zu Server und Cloud Infrastruktur. Das Team arbeitet praxisnah, kollegial und kundennah, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Die technische Leitung mit Architektur, Standards und Sicherheit liegt bei dir und dem Engineering Lead im Team. Du verantwortest zusätzlich den Betrieb: Planung, Steuerung und Qualität des Supports.      Deine Aufgaben    Du führst das Supportteam fachlich und organisatorisch und entwickelst es weiter.  Du steuerst den täglichen Betrieb: Eingang, Triage, Prioritäten und Zuteilung der Tickets.  Du planst Einsätze, Termine und Kapazitäten für Support und Kundenprojekte.  Du stellst sicher, dass die vereinbarten Reaktionszeiten eingehalten werden, und führst das Team mit wenigen klaren Kennzahlen.  Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Kunden bei Störungen und Eskalationen und informierst proaktiv.  Du planst und koordinierst Kundenprojekte wie Migrationen, Übernahmen oder Telefonie, zusammen mit dem Engineering Lead.  Du arbeitest selbst im Support mit, vor allem in der ersten und zweiten Stufe.  Du entwickelst Prozesse, Checklisten und Dokumentation weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.  Du bringst die Anforderungen aus dem Betrieb in die Weiterentwicklung des eigenen Supportportals ein.       Dein Profil    Ausbildung als Informatikerin oder Informatiker EFZ, HF oder vergleichbare Erfahrung.  Mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT Support oder bei einem Managed Service Provider, idealerweise mit Verantwortung für Planung, Dispatch oder ein Team.  Du denkst in Prioritäten, Terminen und Kundennutzen und behältst auch unter Druck den Überblick.  Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, RMM und Monitoring. Kenntnisse im Servicemanagement, zum Beispiel ITIL, sind ein Plus.  Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, Windows Clients und Server, dazu Grundlagen in Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und VoIP.  Klare und freundliche Kommunikation mit Kunden und im Team, sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ist ein Plus.  Du übernimmst Verantwortung, arbeitest strukturiert und führst gerne.       Das erwartet dich    Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem Team, das wachsen will.  Ein Engineering Lead an deiner Seite für Technik und Architektur, damit du dich auf Betrieb, Kunden und Team konzentrieren kannst.  Ein eigenes Supportportal, das mit deinen Anforderungen weiterentwickelt wird.  Moderne Technologien und abwechslungsreiche Kundenumge

description: At IAG, we’re ready for you. We're the largest general insurance group in Australia and New Zealand. Our family of brands turns the IAG purpose of making your world a safer place into action by helping everyday Aussies and New Zealanders, supporting their ambitions and making insurance accessible.    Lead the team that keeps critical technology services running smoothly.   Play a key role in helping technology services stay reliable, resilient and responsive. Confidence working through ambiguity and supporting teams during periods of change.   An understanding of technology transformation, platform modernisation or large-scale operational environments. title: Project Delivery Lead
description: Build something monumental for Healthcare!   At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.  We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!   About The Role   As Project Delivery Lead, you will help Swedish municipalities successfully implement and adopt Tandem across their healthcare and social care services. You will lead complex deployments, build trusted relationships with municipal stakeholders, and drive the change management needed for our technology to deliver meaningful improvements to everyday workflows.  Alongside owning a portfolio of key customers, you will provide day-to-day leadership to the Project Delivery team, supporting colleagues, coordinating implementations, and improving how we deliver as we grow. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Medical Operations to ensure successful implementations and long-term customer value.  What you will do    Lead municipal implementations: Own end-to-end implementations, from kickoff and planning through to training, go-live, and ongoing adoption, adapting the approach to each municipality’s organisation, workflows, and needs.   Lead and develop the team: Provide day-to-day people leadership, supporting team members in managing complex projects, resolving customer challenges, and developing their stakeholder management skills. Identify development needs, support performance improvement, and contribute to hiring and onboarding new team members.   Manage key customer relationships: Build trusted relationships with municipal leaders, social services and healthcare managers, social workers, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders. Lead customer reviews, demonstrate outcomes, and identify opportunities to improve adoption and expand usage.   Drive adoption and customer value: Help municipalities embed Tandem into their everyday workflows, ensuring social workers and healthcare professionals understand the technology and realise its benefits in reducing documentation burden.   Lead change management: Support municipalities in introducing new ways of working, engaging managers and frontline staff early, identifying champions, addressing concerns, and establishing routines that last beyond go-live. Develop change management practices that can be applied consistently across the Project Delivery team.   Lead day-to-day delivery operations: Coordinate concurrent implementations, support colleagues with complex challenges, manage workloads and escalations, and maintain consistent standards of implementation quality.   Improve delivery process

description:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. - Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)

- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumen

About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

title: Production Scheduler
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook

title: (Senior) Expansion Manager:in (m/w/d) für Standortakquise in Leipzig

Realisiere mit Fastned die Mobilität von morgen!

Wir wollen unser Expansionsteam für die Region Ost rund um Leipzig verstärken. 

Die Mobilität verändert sich grundlegend. Elektrofahrzeuge werden zum Alltag, neue Technologien entwickeln sich rasant und der Bedarf an leistungsfähiger Ladeinfrastruktur wächst. Fastned gestaltet als Unternehmen für ultraschnelles Laden diese Entwicklung aktiv mit.

title: Senior Softwareentwickler / Engineer – Backend & Cloud (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns

Wir sind ein Startup aus Hannover und entwickeln eine KI-gestützte Computer-Vision-Plattform für die industrielle Qualitätsprüfung. Unsere Full-Stack-Anwendungen laufen produktiv bei Industriekunden und decken alles ab, von Datenmanagement und Annotation bis zu Modelltraining und Deployment. Dich erwartet ein Engineering-Team von rund 20 Personen mit modernen Arbeitsstrukturen und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Backend-Services: REST-APIs, SQL, Datenbankmigrationen

  • Erfahrung in agiler Zusammenarbeit und im Umgang mit Tools wie Linear, Jira oder vergleichbaren Lösungen

  • Sicherheit über den gesamten Stack: Du debuggst APIs, prüfst Infrastrukturänderungen und diskutierst Architekturentscheidungen

  • Pragmatische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Eigenverantwortung

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse im beruflichen Alltag

Wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung mit Computer Vision, ML-Plattformen, Distributed Computing oder datenintensiven S

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Du liebst es, Events auf die Beine zu stellen, und weißt, wie man Social-Media-Kanäle lebendig hält? Dann passt du zu uns.

Als Marketing Manager sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Messen und Veranstaltungen reibungslos laufen und unsere Social-Media-Kanäle konsequent bespielt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit der Marketingleitung zusammen, hältst im Team die Fäden zusammen und wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein.

Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel.

Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Marketingteam, in dem deine Ideen gehört und umgesetzt werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du recherchierst und bewertest neue Messen und Veranstaltungen und bringst sie für uns an den Start.
  • Du planst und setzt Messen, Netzwerkveranstaltungen, Webinare und Objektvorstellungen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung um.
  • Du übernimmst die komplette Organisation rund um jedes Event: Anmeldung, Standplanung, Hotel und Reise, Material sowie die Abstimmung mit Ausstellern und Dienstleistern.
  • Du begleitest eigene Formate wie Tage der offenen Tür, Preisbewerbungen und Postmailings.
  • Du bereitest jedes Event sauber nach: Du übergibst Kontakte ins CRM, sammelst Fotos und Material und hältst Learnings fest.
  • Du steuerst unsere Social-Media-Kanäle (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube), planst Beiträge nach Redaktionsplan ein und veröffentlichst sie.
  • Du betreust Stories, zum Beispiel Einblicke hinter die Kulissen und von unterwegs, und kümmerst dich um das Community-Management.
  • Du hältst Kanäle und Profile aktuell und gestaltest die Ausrichtung der Kanäle aktiv mit.

description:

Als Performance Marketing Manager setzt du unsere bezahlten Kampagnen auf, steuerst und wertest sie aus, damit qualifizierte Leads bei unserem Vertrieb ankommen. Du bist der Filter zwischen Anzeige und Beratungsgespräch und verantwortest deine Kampagnen vom ersten Tag an eigenständig.

Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel.

Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketingleitung und Vertrieb zusammen und siehst direkt, welchen Beitrag deine Kampagnen zum Geschäftserfolg leisten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du baust Kampagnen in Meta, Google und LinkedIn auf und steuerst sie im Rahmen eines festen Quartalsbudgets.

  • Du baust Google Ads als eigenen Schwerpunkt aus: Search und Display, Keywords, negative Keywords und Suchintentionen.

  • Du richtest ein sauberes Tracking ein, inklusive UTM-Parametern, und verknüpfst die Kampagnen mit HubSpot.

  • Du optimierst laufende Kampagnen kontinuierlich über Zielgruppen, Gebote, Creatives und A/B-Tests.

  • Du entwickelst Wording und Framing für Objekt- und Rabattaktionen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung.

  • Du briefst Bild-Creatives bei unserem Digital Designer und Videos bei unserem Video Editor und prüfst sie vor dem Go-live auf Briefing und Plattformformate.

  • Du wertest deine Kampagnen aus: Kosten pro Lead, Anteil qualifizierter Leads, Terminquote und Kosten pro Abschluss.

title: Customer Success Associate (m/w/d)
description:
Über Sparrks

Sparrks ist eine digitale 1:1- und Team-Coaching Plattform, die Unternehmen mit über 280 zertifizierten Executive Coaches verbindet und Führungskräfte sowie Talente durch personalisiertes Coaching nachhaltig in ihrer Entwicklung unterstützt. Das Team in Berlin arbeitet daran, wirksame Personalentwicklung für DAX-Unternehmen, Top-Beratungen und führende Scale-ups zugänglich zu machen. Für die Betreuung unserer Kunden und Coachees suchen wir Dich als engagierte*n Customer Success Associate (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist Hauptansprechperson für unsere Kunden, meist Leitungen aus HR oder Learning & Development, sowie für die Coachees selbst.

  • Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung unserer Coaching-Programme.

  • Du bereitest regelmäßige Kundentermine mit Datenanalysen und Präsentationen vor, führst sie durch und stellst die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden sicher.

  • Du treibst strategische und operative Sales-Aktivitäten bei Bestandskunden voran und entwickelst die Accounts zu ihrem vollen Potenzial.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts ein und wächst gemeinsam mit uns in einem spannenden Markt.

Dein Profil

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der BWL, Psychologie, Kommunikation oder einer vergleichbaren Richtung.

  • Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Account Management, Partnermanagement, Recruiting, Service, Community Management oder im direkten Kundenkontakt.

  • Einen offenen, positiven und beziehungsorientierten Kommunikationsstil, mit dem Du überzeugst.

  • Geschick im Aufbau von Beziehungen und die Fähigkeit, auch schwierige Gespräche mit Klarheit und Wertschätzung zu führen.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Daten fundierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

  • Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, mit der Du mühelos mehrere Bälle in der Luft

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

In den kommenden Jahren wollen wir unseren Wachstumskurs deutlich beschleunigen und MY HEALTH&BEAUTY als die führende Marke für ästhetische Medizin und Longevity etablieren.

Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir mit MY HEALTH & BEAUTY aktiv voran.

description:
About Nexoya

We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.

The role

You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.

AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

  • Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

  • Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

  • You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

  • Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

  • Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

  • Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

  • Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails.

title: Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion
description:
About Promethion Industries

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our mission is to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces through tightly integrated autonomy stacks designed and built in Europe. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion to build the estimation backbone that allows our aircraft to understand their own motion without depending on GNSS.

Your mission with us

  • Build the state-estimation and sensor-fusion backbone of our autonomous aerial systems.

  • Develop robust vehicle-state estimation for high-dynamic flight and GNSS-degraded or GNSS-denied environments.

  • Fuse IMUs, cameras, optical flow, airspeed, GNSS, barometers and other sensors into reliable low-latency estimates.

  • Develop, integrate and deploy VIO, visual odometry, ego-motion optical flow and inertial-estimation approaches.

  • Own temporal calibration, sensor synchronisation, coordinate frames and estimator consistency.

  • Diagnose drift, bias, observability and timing problems from first principles.

  • Work directly with real flight logs and hardware to reproduce estimator failures and rapidly improve performance.

  • Build graceful degradation when individual sensors become unreliable or unavailable.

  • Quantify estimator uncertainty and expose meaningful confidence and health information to downstream autonomy and control systems.

  • Evaluate alternative estimation architectures including direct velocity estimation and continuous-time approaches where they provide advantages at high dynamics.

Your contribution to the team

title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description:
About Singular Photonics:

Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution.

About the Role:

We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host.

Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment.

You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams.
  • RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control.
  • Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware.
  • Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado.
  • High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link.

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Our solutions cater to various stakeholders, including industry regulators, developers, designers, consultants, contractors, equipment and material manufacturers, and sectors like city operation, finance, and education. We leverage core digital technologies and systematic digital capabilities to drive high-quality development in the construction industry. By 2025, Glodon had set up 8 major R&D centers and over 80 subsidiaries worldwide, with a sales and service network spanning over 100 countries and regions, serving 390,000 corporate clients with professional products and services.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execu

title: Associate Counsel, Product and Marketing
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We are hiring a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Counsel to join our Legal team.

As Associate Counsel, Product and Marketing, you will be a partner to your business colleagues and advise multiple Toast teams including product, engineering, marketing, compliance, and sales teams. You will learn Toast's products, strategies, and processes, and help the business identify and mitigate legal risk while helping Toast grow and evolve.

Our Legal & Compliance teams are primarily concentrated in Boston, New York, Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Chicago. Candidates residing in these areas will be prioritized, as they will benefit from closer proximity to colleagues and greater access to company resources and events.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Supporting legal team members in advising stakeholders across the product, engineering, and marketing teams, from early product development through launch, including the review of marketing strategies and assets.
  • Performing first-pass review of advertising and marketing collateral, including claim substantiation, disclosures, promotions and sweepstakes, and endorsements and testimonials.
  • Supporting the review of hardware product development, identifying legal risks in areas such as product labeling and regulatory certifications.
  • Supporting Toast's trademark portfolio development and enforcement efforts, including investigating potential third-party infringement, preparing cease-and-desist letters and takedown requests, and tracking matters through resolution.
  • Researching and summarizing U.S. and international laws and regulations relevant to the Toast platform, products, services, and marketing activities.
  • Helping maintain and improve scalable processes for providing legal input to business partners, such as review checklists, templates, FAQs, and intake workflows.
  • Working collaboratively across functions to build an understanding of how Toast products work and how applicable laws and regulations shape their development.
  • Managing your own deliverables, communicating clearly on routine matters, and collaborating with other legal team members as needed.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • A J.D. from an ABA-accredited U.S. law school, and membership in good standing to at least one state bar.
  • 3-4+ years of legal experience, preferably advising corporate and commercial entities.
  • Familiarity with marketing and product-related laws and regulations, and with core privacy concepts.
  • Experience supporting the review of advertising and market

title: Growth Marketing Manager

Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

title: B2B Marketing - Nordics
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Marketing
description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner closely with Marketing, Finance, Retail, and Product to translate marketing data into better decisions and business outcomes. Your work will help Oura improve marketing efficiency, optimize spend allocation, strengthen channel and revenue measurement foundations, and build scalable decision systems that make our go-to-market organization smarter over time.

This is a full-stack applied data science role that requires strong data foundations, pragmatic model development, and the ability to turn technical models into operational and strategic action. title: Staff Product Marketing Manager (PMM), Provider Experience
description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role:

Headway has built the largest network of mental health providers in the country, with 85,000 active and growing. As we scale, we have an opportunity to deepen how providers understand, experience, and value Headway across their journey. Ultimately, we want to be the partner providers count on to build a thriving practice and help more patients make progress toward their goals.

We're looking for a Staff Product Marketing Manager to help providers discover, adopt, and get lasting value from the products and experiences Headway builds. You'll shape how we bring new capabilities to market, build a differentiated story around the value Headway delivers, and help providers see us as a partner in building a thriving practice.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Provider Marketing. You'll partner closely with Provider Experience, Design, Lifecycle Marketing, Research, Creative, and other marketing teams to turn provider insight into strategies that drive product adoption, engagement, and retention. This is a role for someone who likes building.

  • You Will:

    • Build deep provider insight. Understand provider needs, behaviors, and the competitive landscape, and bring that perspective into Product decisions.

    • Own provider positioning and messaging. Turn provider insight and product capabilities into a clear, differentiated story that helps providers understand our value and deepens trust over time.

    • Lead Provider Experience GTM. Bring new products and capabilities to market, leading strategies that drive adoption, engagement, and retention.

Phullcutz ist ein Online-Shop für Barber- und Friseurbedarf mit eigenen Marken. Unsere Videos erreichen über 2 Mio. Views im Monat auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube. Wir wollen mehr. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unsere Video-Maschine baut und am Laufen hält.

Du lieferst konstant Output (Ziel: rund 10 Shorts pro Woche). Die Reichweite wächst. Die Creator-Kooperationen laufen.

title: Manager Implementatie & Groei Backoffice Uitzendbranche
description: 📍  Standplaats: Tilburg | Fulltime    Wil jij bouwen aan de organisatie achter een snelgroeiende backofficepartner? Krijg je energie van structuur, processen en mensen die samen één doel halen? Dan zoeken we jou.    Yaper  groeit. Onze klanten worden groter, implementaties worden complexer en steeds meer afdelingen zijn betrokken bij een succesvolle onboarding. Wat een paar jaar geleden vanzelf ging, vraagt nu om regie, structuur en eigenaarschap. Daarom maken we een nieuwe managementfunctie. Jij zorgt dat nieuwe intermediairs snel en soepel landen, van de commerciële overdracht tot het moment dat ze volledig meedraaien in onze reguliere dienstverlening.  Daarnaast help je Yaper verder professionaliseren, zodat onze organisatie klaar blijft voor de volgende groeifase.       Wat ga je doen?    Je neemt de regie zodra Sales een nieuwe intermediair heeft binnengehaald.  Je maakt de implementatieplanning en bewaakt kwaliteit, voortgang en klanttevredenheid.  Je stemt af met Sales, Servicedesk, Backoffice, Finance en Applicatiebeheer. Zo weet iedereen wat er moet gebeuren en wat de klant is beloofd.  Tijdens de implementatie ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de intermediair en voor je collega’s.  Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en commerciële kansen en draagt de klant soepel over aan de reguliere operatie.  Je maakt onboarding sneller en voorspelbaarder. Daarvoor standaardiseer je processen en zet je verbeterprojecten op.  Je geeft direct en indirect leiding aan het Yaper-team.  Als lid van het Management Team denk je mee over onze dienstverlening en groeistrategie.       Wie ben jij?    Je hebt  meerdere jaren ervaring in de uitzend-, payroll- of flexbranche  en kent backofficeprocessen van binnenuit.   Je werkt en denkt op minimaal hbo-niveau .   Je hebt ervaring met project-, implementatie- of verandermanagement .   Je hebt (eerste) ervaring met leidinggeven . Je krijgt mensen mee in verandering en communiceert makkelijk op alle niveaus.   Je bent organisatorisch sterk  en houdt overzicht, ook als er veel tegelijk gebeurt.   Je hebt affiniteit met systemen, data en procesoptimalisatie . Ervaring met  AFAS Flex  is een sterke pré.   Je denkt commercieel en klantgericht , neemt verantwoordelijkheid en bent besluitvaardig als het moet.       Wat bieden wij jou?    Een sleutelrol met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en eigen initiatief.  Een plek in het Management Team en directe invloed op de koers van Yaper.  Korte lijnen, snelle besluitvorming en een informele cultuur.  Een vast salaris van  € 4.500 tot € 5.500 per maand , afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.   Directe invloed op de verdere ontwikkeling van Yaper en ook de hele organisatie.    Een bonusregeling als lid van het Management Team.  Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak en de mogelijkheid tot een leaseauto via salarisuitruil.       Klaar om te bouwen aan de volgende groeifase van Yaper?      Solliciteer nu en zorg dat Yaper blijft groeien!

title: Avainasiakkuuspäällikkö
description: Rakennatko mielelläsi asiakassuhteita, joissa luottamus kasvaa pitkäjänteiseksi ja arvoa tuottavaksi kumppanuudeksi? Innostutko asiakkuuksien tavoitteellisesta kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnin ja työkykyjohtamisen ratkaisujen rakentamisesta yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa?    Toimintamme kasvaessa haemme nyt kahta avainasiakkuuspäällikköä työterveyden avainasiakkuuksista vastaavaan tiimiimme. Haettavana on yksi toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tehtävä sekä määräaikainen sijaisuus helmikuusta 2027 tammikuulle 2028. Molemmat tehtävät ovat kokoaikaisia.    Avainasiakkuuspäällikkönämme pääset vastaamaan nimetyistä yritysasiakkuuksista, syventämään asiakassuhteita ja kehittämään yhteistyötä tavalla, joka tukee sekä asiakkaidemme tavoitteita että asiakkuuksien kasvua ja kannattavuutta.   💡 Millaisesta työstä on kyse? Tavoitteenasi on vahvistaa asiakassuhteita, varmistaa asiakkaiden pysyvyys sekä kasvattaa asiakkuuksien arvoa ja kannattavuutta.  Työssäsi johdat uusien yritysasiakkaiden aloituksia sopimuksesta sujuvaan yhteistyöhön. Kokoat tarvittavat osapuolet yhteen ja huolehdit aloitustoimenpiteiden koordinoinnista, jotta uudelle asiakkuudelle muodostuu hyvä pohja pitkäjänteistä yhteistyötä varten. Tarvittaessa osallistut sopimusneuvotteluihin ja tuot niihin ymmärryksesi asiakkaan tarpeista sekä Pihlajalinnan palveluratkaisuista.  Asiakkaan toimintaympäristön ja tarpeiden ymmärtäminen on työssäsi keskeistä. Rakennat niiden pohjalta työhyvinvointia ja työkykyjohtamista tukevia palveluratkaisuja, johdat ja koordinoit ohjausryhmätoimintaa ja asiakaskohtaamisia sekä raportoit toiminnan kehittymisestä. Huolehdit asiakastyytyväisyydestä ja siitä, että tunnistetut kehittämistarpeet johtavat konkreettisiin toimenpiteisiin. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Pihlajalinnan sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa. Tehtävään ei kuulu esihenkilövastuita.  Näin avainasiakkuuksien asiakkuusjohtaja Niina Karhela, kuvailee avainasiakkuuspäällikön tehtävää:  ”Meillä pääset paitsi kehittämään asiakkuuksia myös vaikuttamaan siihen, miten teemme työtä yhdessä. Saat tilaa tuoda omat ideasi käytäntöön ja tiimin tueksesi – asiakkuuksia johdetaan itsenäisesti, mutta onnistumisia rakennetaan yhdessä.”   ❤️ Unelmien työpaikka Pihlajalinnassa? title: Pasient- og brukerombud
description: Stillingen som pasient- og brukerombud i Vestfold er ledig, og vi søker en trygg, tillitsvekkende og tydelig leder som kan fylle denne viktige rollen. Er det deg vi ser etter?       Stillingen innebærer kontakt med pasienter, brukere, pårørende, helsepersonell, ledere, myndigheter og organisasjoner. Du vil arbeide både med enkeltsaker og med overordnede problemstillinger der målet er bedret kvalitet i helse- og omsorgstjenestene. Du vil være en tydelig stemme for pasienters og brukeres interesser og bidra til at erfaringer fra enkeltsaker omsettes til læring og forbedring.       Du vil representere ombudet utad, arbeide tett med sentrale aktører i helse- og omsorgssektoren og bidra til å sette viktige problemstillinger på dagsorden regionalt og nasjonalt. Som leder har du ansvar for å videreutvikle ombudets samfunnsoppdrag, styrke organisasjonens synlighet og bidra aktivt og konstruktivt inn i samarbeidet mellom kontorene i ordningen. Stillingen innebærer personal-, budsjett-, resultat og fagansvar. Du vil lede et kompetent fagmiljø og ha ansvar for strategi, prioriteringer og resultater. Du må regne med noe reisevirksomhet. Kontoret har p.t. en bemanning på fire personer inkludert deg som leder.    Kvalifikasjoner  Som leder i Pasient- og brukerombudet må du kunne kombinere faglig tyngde med tydelig lederskap. Du evner å håndtere komplekse problemstillinger, ta selvstendige vurderinger og skape resultater gjennom samarbeid internt og eksternt. Pasient- og brukerombudets verdier er tilgjengelig, troverdig og uavhengig, med mot og autoritet. Vi søker derfor en person som er trygg i lederrollen, som kommuniserer klart og som evner å rette oppmerksomhet mot svikt og utfordringer samtidig som du bidrar til konstruktive løsninger.

description: Serviceleder til Netto – ledelse med fokus på kundeservice og trivsel    Er du passioneret omkring ledelse, kundeservice og et stærkt team? Som serviceleder i Netto bliver du den synlige frontfigur, der sikrer, at vores kunder altid møder en indbydende butik og et engageret personale. Du spiller en central rolle i at skabe gode kundeoplevelser, der får folk til at komme igen.  Du er tæt på dit team, går forrest og bygger en kultur, hvor samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus. Alle de gode grunde til at blive serviceleder i Netto    Stillingen er en super mulighed for at være med i et dagligvareeventyr. Du bliver en del af et stærkt team og engagerede kollegaer. Og du har med dit engagement mulighed for at sætte retningen for dit helt eget serviceteam.   Du kan også glæde dig til:      Mulighed for fx akademiuddannelse og lederuddannelse  Konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og bonusordning  Sundhedsforsikring  Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks  Mulighed for leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland  Adgang til Salling online personaleshop med 35% rabat  Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat     Bliv en del af Netto-ånden :  Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab    I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
